raw.description:
Systems, LLC, an affiliate of Chamberlain Group, is a U.S.-based manufacturer of loading dock equipment—marketed under the Poweramp, DLM, and McGuire brands. With manufacturing facilities in Germantown, Wisconsin and Malvern, Arkansas, all products are designed and produced in the USA using lean manufacturing techniques. We strive to recruit the best talent in the industry and give employees opportunities for continuing education and training to help them advance in their careers.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Maintain and increase the sales volume of dealers and end users in accordance with stated company plan; develop sales forecasts and account potentials

  • Develop strong dealer partners and signature accounts in assigned territory in accordance with Sales Leadership

  • Manage assigned dealer and partner relationships to strengthen overall solution capabilities and drive greater value to the customer; address customer inquiries and concerns

  • Increase and maintain average net sales price and meet P&L impact targets at the dealer and end user level by managing pricing programs

  • Travel to facilities and conduct product evaluations and site surveys; conduct customer presentations around product

  • Facilitate quote management and order fulfillment to effectively deliver product, pricing and sales information to customers and team using insights and data

  • Support strategies for marketing to accounts and end users, working directly with systems marketing group

  • Participate in partnership program implementation and negotiation as needed

  • Leverage strong corporate awareness to influence strategic business decisions

  • Represent Sales team on assigned cross-functional projects

  • Participate in trade shows

  • Develop and maintain customer specific construction specifications

  • Comply with health and safety guidelines and rules; managers should also ensure compliance across their teams.

  • Protect Chamberlain Group’s and Systems’ reputation by keeping information confidential.

  • Maintain professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reading professional publications, establishing personal networks, and participating in professional societies.

  • Contribute to the team effort by accomplishing related results and participating on projects as needed.

Minimum Qualifications

Experience:

  • 5+ years of sales experience

  • Experience working with virtual teams and collaboration tools

  • Preference will be given to Arizona, Wisconsin or Las Vegas, NV

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Strong public speaking skills

  • Ability to read and understand blueprints, schematics, manuals, bulletins and other specifications

  • Mechanical aptitude

  • Experience working directly with channel management

  • Experience selling software as a service in support of equipment

  • Proficient in the use of a CRM

  • Able to travel up to 30% - domestically; valid driver's license

  • Emerging technology mindset; excited about new and emerging technologies and a desire to help deliver new connected products and services to customers

The pay range for this position is $98,646.00 - $162,604.00; base pay offered may vary depending on a number of factors including, but not limited to, the position offered, location, education, training, and/or experience. In addition to base pay, also offered is a comprehensive benefits package and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). This position is eligible for participation in a short-term incentive plan subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Chamberlain Group wants all of its employees to succeed and encourages people of all backgrounds to apply. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, and you’ll be considered for this role regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, ancestry; marital, disabled or veteran status. We’re committed to fostering an environment where people of all lived experiences feel welcome.

Persons with disabilities who anticipate needing accommodations for any part of the application process may contact, in confidence .

raw.description:
The Company

InvestX launched in 2014 and is a late-stage venture fund investing out of Fund 5. With over US$700 million in investments and 35+ portfolio companies including Palantir, Anthropic, SpaceX, Airbnb, SoFi, Spotify, DocuSign, and many more, we work with leading North American wealth management firms and family office clients to offer multi-position and single-purpose funds.

InvestX is backed by leading financial institutions including Jefferies, Virtu Financial, and Canaccord Genuity and has been featured in CNBC, Forbes, Bloomberg, U.S. News, Business Insider, Reuters, The Globe and Mail, and other leading publications.

About the Role

We are looking for a driven, high-energy National Accounts, Associate to support the growth of InvestX's U.S. Broker Dealer distribution channel. This is a prospecting-heavy sales role for someone who enjoys opening doors, making cold calls, finding the right decision-makers, and turning new conversations into qualified opportunities.

Working closely with the National Accounts Lead, you will be responsible for building the top of the sales funnel across Broker Dealers and other wealth management firms throughout the U.S. You will research target firms, identify key contacts, execute outbound prospecting campaigns, secure meetings, and help move opportunities through the National Accounts pipeline and approval process.

We're looking for a true hunter mentality: someone persistent, competitive, resourceful, comfortable hearing "no," and motivated by creating opportunities where relationships don't already exist.

Location: United States (Remote) or Hybrid (3-days in office) New York

What You'll Do

Prospect & Build Pipeline

  • Conduct high-volume outbound prospecting into targeted Broker Dealers and wealth management firms across the U.S.
  • Cold call, email, and leverage LinkedIn and other prospecting tools to identify and engage prospective National Accounts.
  • Research target organizations and identify the right home office contacts, decision-makers, investment teams, due diligence professionals, and other key stakeholders.
  • Secure qualified introductory meetings for the National Accounts Lead.
  • Consistently build and maintain a strong pipeline of new opportunities.
  • Follow up persistently and creatively to turn initial outreach into active conversations.
  • Maintain accurate prospecting activity, contacts, opportunities, and next steps within Salesforce.

Support National Accounts

  • Partner closely with the National Accounts Lead to prioritize target firms and execute the broader National Accounts strategy.
  • Prepare research, meeting materials, prospect intelligence, and follow-up for prospective accounts.
  • Support opportunities from initial outreach through due diligence and platform approval.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, Operations, Marketing, and Sales throughout the approval and onboarding process.
  • Track account progress, outstanding requirements, and next steps to keep opportunities moving.
  • Support ongoing engagement with home office contacts, investment committees, due diligence teams, and other stakeholders.

Develop Market Intelligence

  • Build a strong understanding of the Broker Dealer and wealth management landscape.
  • Monitor competitor activity, platform developments, and trends in private markets and alternative investments.
  • Gather market feedback on InvestX's products, positioning, and advisor demand.
  • Identify new firms, contacts, and opportunities that should be added to the National Accounts pipeline.

What We're Looking For

  • 3–5+ years of sales, business development, wholesaling, or distribution experience within wealth management, asset management, financial services, or alternative investments.
  • Demonstrated success in outbound prospecting, cold calling, and generating qualified sales opportunities.
  • Comfortable spending a significant portion of the day actively prospecting and engaging new contacts.
  • A natural hunter who is energized by building relationships from scratch rather than solely managing established accounts.
  • Persistent and resilient—you are comfortable with rejection and know consistent follow-up is part of successful sales.
  • Strong communication skills and confidence engaging senior investment and wealth management professionals.
  • Curious and resourceful, with the ability to research organizations and find the right path into an account.
  • Highly organized with strong CRM and pipeline management discipline.
  • Self-directed and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Collaborative and comfortable supporting a senior National Accounts leader while taking ownership of your prospecting activity and results.

Nice to Have

  • Existing relationships within the Broker Dealer, RIA, or broader wealth management ecosystem.
  • Experience with private equity, private credit, venture capital, hedge funds, or alternative investment products.
  • Familiarity with Broker Dealer due diligence and platform approval processes.
  • Experience using Salesforce and sales prospecting platforms.
  • FINRA Series 7 and 63 or willingness to obtain relevant licensing.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured primarily by your ability to create qualified opportunities and expand the National Accounts pipeline, including:

  • Consistent outbound prospecting activity and new account penetration.
  • Qualified meetings generated with targeted firms.
  • Growth of the National Accounts pipeline for new Broker Dealers
  • Conversion of prospects into active due diligence and approval opportunities.
  • Progression of firms through the approval process.
  • Strong CRM discipline and consistent follow-through.
  • Contribution to new platform approvals and, ultimately, asset growth.

Salary & Benefits 

  • 2026 base salary range is $130,000 - $160,000 USD plus incentive plan and equity. 
  • Actual salaries may vary based on factors, such as skill, experience, location, and qualifications for the role.   
  • Comprehensive Health & Benefit plan.

If this opportunity sounds like it is a good match with your skills, background and career direction, please apply through our Careers Page ()

with your cover letter and resume.

raw.description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Kafka Platform Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $130,000–$180,000 Annually (based on experience)
Experience Required:10+ Years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a highly experienced Kafka Platform Engineer with 10+ years of experience in distributed systems, event streaming, and platform engineering, including extensive expertise with Apache Kafka and the Confluent Platform. The ideal candidate will architect, deploy, and manage enterprise-scale streaming platforms that power mission-critical, real-time data processing across the organization. This role requires deep technical expertise in Kafka internals, platform automation, security, observability, and cloud-native infrastructure, along with the ability to mentor engineering teams and define enterprise event-streaming standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, deploy, and manage highly available Apache Kafka and Confluent Platform environments supporting enterprise-scale event-driven applications.
  • Design Kafka cluster topology, broker configuration, partitioning strategies, replication, capacity planning, and performance optimization for high-throughput workloads.
  • Implement enterprise-grade security using SASL, SSL/mTLS, ACLs, RBAC, encryption, and authentication mechanisms.
  • Design and manage Kafka Connect, Schema Registry, Kafka Streams, ksqlDB, and event streaming pipelines for real-time data integration.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Ansible, or similar automation frameworks to provision and manage Kafka infrastructure.
  • Design and implement High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), backup, failover, and cross-region replication strategies.
  • Build comprehensive monitoring, alerting, logging, and observability solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK, and Confluent monitoring tools.
  • Optimize cluster performance, troubleshoot production issues, conduct root cause analysis, and implement long-term platform improvements.
  • Support Kafka deployments on Kubernetes using Strimzi, Confluent Operator, or managed cloud services including AWS MSK, Azure Event Hubs (Kafka API), and Confluent Cloud.
  • Collaborate with application developers, data engineers, DevOps, SRE, and enterprise architects to establish event-driven architecture standards and best practices.
  • Conduct architecture reviews, establish platform governance, perform code reviews, and mentor engineers on Kafka development and operations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of professional experience in distributed systems, platform engineering, or infrastructure engineering, including 5+ years of hands-on Apache Kafka or Confluent Platform experience.
  • Expert-level knowledge of Kafka internals, including partitions, replication, brokers, ISR, consumer groups, offset management, and performance tuning.
  • Extensive experience implementing Kafka security using SASL, SSL/mTLS, ACLs, RBAC, and enterprise authentication mechanisms.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Kafka Connect, Schema Registry, Kafka Streams, ksqlDB, and real-time event streaming architectures.
  • Experience implementing High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), multi-cluster replication, and cross-region failover strategies.
  • Advanced scripting skills using Python, Bash, or Go, along with Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools.
  • Strong experience with observability platforms including Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK, and distributed tracing solutions.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, documentation, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Confluent Certified Administrator or Confluent Certified Developer certification.
  • Experience operating Kafka on Kubernetes using Strimzi, Confluent Operator, or similar operators.
  • Hands-on experience with managed Kafka services including AWS MSK, Confluent Cloud, Azure Event Hubs (Kafka API), or Google Cloud Managed Kafka.
  • Experience with stream processing technologies such as Apache Flink, Apache Spark Structured Streaming, or Apache Beam.
  • Knowledge of data governance, schema evolution, metadata management, and data lineage for streaming platforms.

How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity?
For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 505-3545. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.
Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Controller - Full-time

BELAY is a growing and vibrant, Atlanta, GA-based company that offers remote, U.S.-based Assistant and Financial staffing solutions. We are a fast-paced team of high performers that work extremely hard, but also know how to have a great time. Culture is a top priority and our values are lived out daily.

Who is BELAY? Click here and enjoy!

Below are the position requirements.

Job purpose

Controllers serve as trusted advisors and fractional Controllers for our small- to mid-sized business clients. They act as strategic partners, aligning financial services with client goals for growth, profitability, and compliance. By combining technical expertise with business insight, they guide owners through financial decision-making while collaborating closely with internal accounting team members to deliver high-quality financial support.

Our Controllers are professional, detail-focused, and adaptable to evolving technologies and business needs. They proactively identify opportunities for improvement, connect clients with additional resources, and deliver consistent, high-quality service. Internally, they contribute to process improvements, cross-functional collaboration, and operational excellence to support both client success and firm-wide growth.

Duties and responsibilities

As a BELAY Controller, you will professionally represent the company in all virtual and in-person interactions. You are expected to exemplify our mission, vision, and core values daily, fostering a collaborative and positive team environment.

Client Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for clients, leading financial review calls
  • Serve as a key resource for complex client accounting matters and provide guidance on accounting decisions raised by both clients and internal accounting team members
  • Provide proactive insight by identifying risks, opportunities, and compliance considerations to support client growth
  • Monitor client engagement health and identify opportunities for additional support, resources, or services as appropriate
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure client needs are met with professionalism and timeliness

Client Team Collaboration & Oversight

  • Partner closely with Senior Accountants, Staff Accountants, Bookkeepers, and alongside CFOs to ensure accurate, timely, and high-quality client deliverables
  • Provide accounting guidance and subject matter expertise related to complex client needs and financial matters
  • Support workflow coordination and prioritization in partnership with leadership
  • Contribute to a collaborative, accountable, and service-oriented team environment
  • Share knowledge, best practices, and process improvements to support overall team effectiveness

Operational & Strategic Contributions

  • Identify and implement process improvements that enhance efficiency while maintaining compliance
  • Contribute to internal training resources, process documentation, and knowledge-sharing initiatives
  • Participate in internal initiatives that support strategic goals and evolving client needs
  • Stay informed on industry trends and emerging technologies to continuously improve client service delivery

Qualifications

This role requires a motivated and trustworthy self-starter with strong communication and technological skills, who thrives independently and as part of a team, and is willing to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! Our ideal Controller is flexible, creative, well-organized and will conduct relational and efficient coaching at all times.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or Business
  • 6–8 years of progressive accounting experience
  • Strong Controller-level expertise, including explaining financial statements, interpreting KPIs and understanding forecasts and budgets
  • Expertise in financial close processes and best practices
  • Proficiency with accounting and business platforms (e.g., QuickBooks Online, Fathom, Shopify, Cin7, Amazon)
  • Experience advising small businesses in industries such as inventory-based retail/e-commerce, creative/project-based companies, or technology startups
  • Familiarity with accounting and tax methodology, as well as small business economic trends.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage utilization, staffing, and profitability
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to inspire high-performing teams
  • Track record of delivering exceptional client service and strategic guidance to small businesses and startups

Working conditions

BELAY Corporate offers full-time remote work, requiring a dedicated, distraction-free home office for standard Monday-Friday business hours, with occasional travel for some roles. As a full-time, exempt W-2 employee, you'll join a vibrant, award-winning company culture where you're a valued, engaged team player in a thriving organization.

Direct reports

N/A

Physical Requirements

This position primarily requires prolonged sitting, frequent computer use, and participation in virtual meetings. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

Salary Range

$55,000 - $85,000

Location Requirements

This role is remote within the U.S. However, due to employment and tax compliance considerations, we are currently unable to hire employees in the following states: California, New York, Illinois, Oregon.

About Peachy Insurance

Peachy Insurance is an inclusive, remote-friendly organization with compassionate professionals who strive to exceed their goals every day. Here at Peachy, we exist to make a difference in the insurance world by delivering exceptional service and building lasting relationships with our customers.

Overview

We are looking for a professional, organized, and customer-focused Remote Licensed Customer Outreach Specialist to proactively connect with our existing customers. This role is responsible for strengthening customer relationships by conducting policy reviews, discussing upcoming renewals, following up on billing concerns, identifying opportunities to improve coverage, and ensuring customers receive the highest level of service.

This position also provides administrative support to our agency and requires someone who is comfortable balancing customer outreach with operational tasks.

Applicants must currently hold an active Property & Casualty License or Personal Lines License in their resident state.

Your Typical Workday

  • Join daily team huddles to stay aligned on priorities and goals.

  • Receive ongoing coaching and training to build your insurance knowledge and customer service skills.

  • Make outbound calls to existing customers regarding policy renewals, billing reminders, policy reviews, coverage recommendations, and other service opportunities.

  • Help identify opportunities to improve customers' insurance protection while connecting them with licensed agents when appropriate.

  • Follow up with customers regarding requested documents, outstanding items, or policy servicing needs.

  • Assist with administrative projects including data entry, policy documentation, scheduling, and other operational support.

  • Meet with your manager as needed for coaching, feedback, and professional development.

Qualifications

  • Active Property & Casualty License or Personal Lines License required.

  • Previous insurance agency, customer service, retention, or call center experience preferred.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

  • Comfortable making a high volume of outbound customer calls.

  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.

  • Ability to multitask and work independently in a remote environment.

  • Positive attitude with a genuine passion for helping customers.

Here's What We Offer

  • Hourly Rate + Bonus – Starting at $16/hour plus bonus opportunities.

  • Vacation Time – Start with 4 days of paid vacation, with additional days earned over time.

  • Sabbatical Leave – Enjoy a paid week off every year after 9 months of employment.

  • Comprehensive Benefits – Health, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family.

  • Education & Training Investment – Up to $5,250 per year for continued education and professional development.

  • Financial Planning Support – 401(k) access

  • Career Development – Ongoing coaching, training, and opportunities for advancement.

Here's What We Need From You

  • Build meaningful relationships with our existing customers through proactive outreach.

  • Deliver exceptional customer service during every interaction.

  • Confidently make outbound calls and communicate insurance information clearly and professionally.

  • Stay organized while balancing customer outreach and administrative responsibilities.

  • Be dependable, self-motivated, and committed to helping our customers protect what matters most.

Why Join Peachy Insurance?

  • 100% remote position with a flexible work-from-home environment.

  • Supportive team culture that values collaboration and growth.

  • Opportunities for career advancement within a growing agency.

  • Meaningful work focused on helping customers, not cold calling or high-pressure sales.

  • A company that invests in your success and recognizes your achievements.

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. As the world leader in serving science, our laboratory professionals bring their commitment to accuracy and quality to deliver groundbreaking innovations

The Role

The Program Manager III is a client facing role responsible for managing the client relationship and on time delivery of program objectives. In this role, you would oversee the coordination and management of a program by monitoring program/project status, ensuring adherence to timelines and budgets, and aligning goals of projects to meet needs of the program.

You would act as the primary liaison between the client, business development, and the project team to facilitate the flow of information between all parties. Additionally, the Program Manager III works closely with laboratory management to ensure that the project deliverables meet customer expectations and financial commitments, negotiates and makes real-time decisions with the client, drives compliance to company and project management standards across departments for a cohesive customer experience, provides internal consulting on project management issues and identifies opportunities for process and efficiency improvement, and acts as chief liaison to the operational personnel of major clients and is responsible for large study programs.

  • Responsible for client relationship. Responds to client inquiries, leads client communications

Education and Experience

Department/Group Overview:

Disney Direct to Consumer (DTC) includes premium streaming services with Hulu, a premium streaming service that offers premium originals, current season TV, a massive library of hit series and movies, and live television and Disney+ is the Disney-branded streaming service featuring an incomparable collection of content from its brands and franchises recognized and respected all over the world including Star Wars, Marvel, Pixar, Disney, and NatGeo. Our DTC team is looking for hardworking team-players to join the Viewer Experience team, who will thrive upon the legacy of Disney, and Hulu, embrace unconventional thinking, and who are passionate about contributing to The Walt Disney Company’s direct-to-consumer (DTC) experience through strategic hard work and determination.

Job Summary:

The Disney Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) Viewer Experience organization is seeking a Product Manager, Conversational Support to join the Self-Service Product team. This role sits at the intersection of conversational AI, live support, and customer experience, owning the critical bridge between automated and human-assisted support.You will drive the support journey across chat and voice channels, focusing on live support interactions, seamless transitions from self-service (Help Center, Virtual Assistant, IVR) to live agents, and post-interaction feedback. You’ll design intuitive, delightful support experiences and lead the integrations that power them to reduce friction and improve customer satisfaction at scale.

This is a high-impact role requiring strong product judgment, technical fluency, and customer experience expertise to deliver scalable, reliable solutions that enhance viewer and agent interactions. If you’re excited to shape seamless support experiences through AI and conversational technologies at global scale, we’d love to hear from you.

Responsibilities and Duties of the Role:

  • Own and execute the roadmap for support experiences across chat and voice channels, defining the vision for how viewers move between self-service and live support.

  • Design and optimize conversational experiences, including live chat interactions, transitions from self-service (Help Center, Virtual Assistant, IVR) to live agents, and post-interaction feedback flows to reduce friction and improve resolution.

  • Define integration requirements and partner with engineering to deliver cross-system integrations spanning authentication, routing, context sharing, CRM, localization; This includes evaluating API connections, data flows, and architectural tradeoffs across systems.

  • Drive product execution from requirements through launch, partnering with Engineering, Design, Content, WFM, and Localization teams to deliver scalable solutions.

  • Identify and evaluate opportunities to apply AI and automation across the support experience, translating emerging capabilities into concrete product improvements.

  • Design and implement feedback mechanisms — including CSAT collection for virtual and live agents and quality assessments — and use insights to drive measurable improvements in support quality and customer satisfaction.

  • Define and track product performance metrics; use data and experimentation to identify gaps, validate decisions, and communicate impact to stakeholders.

Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3+ years of product management experience for consumer-facing or enterprise products at global scale.

  • Demonstrated experience owning integrations and understanding data flows across systems, equipped to write detailed requirements, read system architecture diagrams, and drive engineering discussions.

  • Familiarity with contact center technologies, CRM platforms, conversational AI or virtual assistant platforms.

  • Strong analytical skills, defining metrics, running experiments, and using data to prioritize and validate product decisions.

  • Experience driving cross-functional execution across engineering, design, content, and localization teams.

  • Excellent written and communication skills with a proven ability to translate technical complexity for non-technical stakeholders and vice versa.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience shipping conversational products

  • Familiarity with AI or ML-powered products, particularly in a support or conversational context (e.g., agent assist, intent classification, NLU)

  • Experience incorporating AI tools in day-to-day product work to accelerate product delivery

Fully Remote · Vollzeit · Start asap · Direkt mit den Foundern · viel Ownership · wenig Bürokratie · Perspektive Head of Business Development

Ouchie macht Erste Hilfe für Familien einfacher, schöner und alltagstauglicher.

Unsere Erste-Hilfe-Sets sind speziell für Familien mit Kindern entwickelt und kombinieren sinnvolle medizinische Produkte mit einem modernen, kompakten Design.

Denn Pflaster, Kühlkompressen, Wundreinigung & Co. braucht fast jede Familie. Trotzdem sehen die meisten Erste-Hilfe-Sets noch immer aus wie etwas, das man möglichst weit hinten im Schrank versteckt.

Das wollen wir ändern.

Wir bauen Ouchie als moderne First-Aid-Brand für Familien auf, vom Erste-Hilfe-Set zu Hause über Reise und Freizeit bis hin zu hilfreichen Produkten, die Eltern und Kinder gerne dabei haben.

Heute verkaufen wir Ouchie bereits direkt an Endkunden. Der nächste große Schritt ist Retail.

Unser Ziel: Ouchie soll dort stehen, wo Familien einkaufen, in Deutschland und perspektivisch international.

Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der unseren Retail-Vertrieb mit uns von Grund auf aufbaut.

Aufgaben

Wir suchen einen Self-Starter, der sich fragt: „Wo müsste Ouchie eigentlich überall stehen und wie bekommen wir es dort ins Regal?“ Und es dann umsetzt.

  • Aufbau des ouchie Retail Geschäfts
  • Identifikation spannender Händler und neuer Vertriebskanäle
  • Aktive Ansprache potenzieller Retail-Partner
  • Cold Outreach per E-Mail, LinkedIn, Telefon – und wo immer es sinnvoll ist
  • Ansprache von kleinen unabhängigen Stores bis hin zu großen Handelsketten
  • Recherche relevanter Einkaufsverbände und Händlernetzwerke
  • Teilnahme an Kinder-, Spielwaren-, Lifestyle- und Retail-Messen
  • Aufbau von Beziehungen zu Einkäufern, Category Managern und Entscheidern

Qualifikation

Wen wir suchen

  • Extrem selbstständig und hands-on
  • Hunter-Mentalität und Spaß an Sales
  • Du wartest nicht auf Leads, du findest sie selbst
  • Keine Scheu vor Cold Calls oder Einkäufern großer Handelsketten
  • Starkes kommerzielles Verständnis
  • Lust am Arbeiten mit Ki-Tools und Aufbau von Ki-gestützten Prozessen
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch
  • Schnell, pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert

Nice-to-Haves (kein muss! Motivation und Ambition ist wichtiger als Erfahrung)

  • Erfahrung in Business Development, Sales oder Key Account Management
  • Erfahrung mit Retail, FMCG, Baby/Kids oder Consumer Brands
  • Kontakte zu Einkäufern oder Distributoren
  • Erfahrung mit Drogerien, Spielwaren-, Kinderfach- oder Apothekenhandel

Benefits

  • Viel Ownership: Du baust den Bereich direkt mit unserem Gründer auf.
  • Große Bandbreite: Vom ersten kleinen Händler bis zur internationalen Listung.
  • Fully Remote: Reisebereitschaft für wichtige Kundentermine und Messen.
  • Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Neue Vertriebskanäle ausprobieren, Prozesse bauen und Deals closen.
  • Ungedeckelte, sehr gute erfolgsabhängige Vergütung aus Fixum und Bonus.
  • 100% remote möglich

Bewerbung: CV oder LinkedIn-Profil reichen.

Schick uns zusätzlich kurz:

  1. Warum reizt dich die Rolle?
  2. Welche 5 Retailer oder Vertriebskanäle würdest du für Ouchie als Erstes angehen?
  3. Wie würdest du vorgehen, wenn du Ouchie in eine Handelskette bringen willst, dort aber noch niemanden kennst?

Wir freuen uns auf dich.

raw.title: Full Stack Engineer

raw.description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position

We're assembling a small founding team to build something genuinely hard: high-throughput services that inspect live traffic, terminate and analyze TLS in the data path, and hold near-zero latency while doing it. This is real systems engineering — streaming, distributed, latency-obsessed — not another CRUD app behind a form.

You won't be starting cold. You inherit real infrastructure and real users, which means what you build reaches production in weeks, not years. The work is high-leverage from day one, and there's nowhere to hide — in the best way.

AI-native. Non-negotiable. You leverage AI to operate as a 10x engineer — demonstrable AI proficiency is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have.

What You'll Own

You take a capability from a rough idea all the way to production, and then you keep it alive and healthy there — meeting its latency and reliability targets, instrumented well enough to prove it, and hardened to survive real load and real failure. You own the outcome, not the ticket. You'll lead a functional area end to end: set its technical direction, make the calls that matter, and pull other engineers along with you.

Who You Are

  • You see what needs to exist and you go build it — you spot the gap, scope it yourself, and start, instead of waiting for someone to hand you a task or a spec.
  • You lead by taking the hardest, least-defined part of the problem and making it work, and others follow because your judgment and output earn it — not because of a title.
  • You own the entire arc — design, build, ship, operate — and you treat what happens in production as your responsibility, making sure the system behaves exactly within the parameters it's supposed to, not just that it passed in staging.
  • When you hit the edge of what you know — a protocol you've never touched, a failure mode you've never seen — curiosity and sheer grit carry you across it faster than most people expect.
  • "Good enough" makes you uncomfortable; you hold a high bar for yourself and ship work you're genuinely proud to put your name on.

What You Bring

  • Proven, demonstrable proficiency using AI as a force multiplier — you already operate as a 10x engineer, orchestrating AI tools and agents to design, build, and ship far beyond what you could alone, while keeping the judgment to know what "correct" actually looks like.
  • 5–7+ years building and operating production services and front ends, with real experience owning something end to end and carrying the weight of it once it's in front of real users.
  • Hands-on experience with TLS / MITM inspection and the security-sensitive edge cases that come with sitting in the middle of live traffic.
  • A real track record of taming latency in streaming and distributed systems — you've chased down p99 tail latency and know that "fast on my machine" means nothing until it's fast in production, under load, with observability to back it up.
  • Strong command of a modern backend language (Go, Rust, or TypeScript/Node) and React/TypeScript on the front end, with a deep working grasp of HTTP, TLS, gRPC/REST, and async/streaming I/O.

Description

Nebius Academy is an educational platform helping business professionals and operations teams stay ahead of the automation curve. We build specialized courses that teach practitioners how to design, implement, and scale AI-powered workflows using modern automation tools — from no-code platforms to enterprise-grade integrations.

Our programs are built for people who work in the real world: operations managers, business analysts, automation engineers, and digital transformation leads. We help them move beyond manual processes and become confident architects of intelligent workflows.

Our mission is to give professionals the knowledge and hands-on skills to automate smarter — and lead their organizations through the shift.

Who are we looking for?

We are building a talent pool of automation practitioners and business technology experts for ongoing roles as Instructors, Authors, and Subject Matter Experts in our AI Automation program.

We are looking for specialists across a range of seniority levels and focus areas:

  • Junior (Instructor / Technical Trainer) — 1–3 years designing or supporting automation workflows. Hands-on experience with tools like Zapier, Make, or n8n. Comfortable walking learners through workflows step-by-step with practical, repeatable examples.
  • Mid (Author / Automation Engineer) — 3–6 years implementing automation across business operations. Experience with API integrations, prompt engineering, and RPA platforms. Able to explain automation concepts clearly and debug issues in real time.
  • Senior (Subject Matter Expert / Automation Architect) — 6+ years in automation solution architecture, complex integrations, and large-scale project delivery. Experienced working with both technical teams and business stakeholders. Strong background in business analysis and digital transformation.

A strong candidate doesn't just know automation tools — they use them daily and can teach others to do the same. We look for practitioners who have replaced real manual processes with working solutions, not just people who have studied the theory.

These are Talent Pool positions — we continuously review applications and build our roster of experts. There may not be an immediate opening at the time you apply, but strong candidates will be added to our talent pool and contacted as relevant opportunities arise.

You can join us on a part-time basis (10–15 hours per week) as an instructor leading live sessions and workshops, as a course author creating learning materials, or as a subject matter expert supporting curriculum development.

Apply now — we review applications on an ongoing basis. Our selection process is fully asynchronous and designed to respect your time:

  1. Application Review — we evaluate your profile against our current needs

Please submit your resume in English.

Available Roles

We are building a talent pool of Instructors, Authors, and Subject Matter Experts for our AI Automation educational programs. We hire on an ongoing basis across the following specializations:

Nice-to-have

Position Overview:

The Loan Processor is responsible for providing quality customer service by obtaining necessary documentation to underwrite the loan and orders third party documentation by communicating directly with the customer and/or Loan Officer. The Loan Processor provides proper disclosures when required by applicable local, state, and federal regulations.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Perform a thorough review and analysis of borrower’s credit, employment, income, and assets as required by the loan program before submitting to underwriting.

  • Assemble the complete loan package in proper order for underwriting.

  • Verify all required documentation (pre-underwrite) in the file.

  • Complete the required loan checklist.

  • Verify that an application is complete and accurate; identify any potential issues that may arise in underwriting.

  • Prepare a loan approval summary, Forms 1008 and 1003, and ensure the accuracy of all the information printed on the documents; communicate directly with the Loan Originator, customer, and Underwriter to obtain initial and any missing documentation required to qualify for the loan.

  • Review loans for compliance with all mortgage-related regulations (RESPA, TIL, HMDA, Reg. B, etc.) and prepare required disclosures.

  • Communicate with various companies to obtain Property Survey, Flood Certificate, Title Commitment, and payoff information.

  • Verify that vendor orders are complete, invoices are received and in the applicant’s E-file.

  • Manage pipeline by completing and submitting reports within allotted turn-around times.

  • Assist set-up of loans.

  • Document all communication related to the loan application in the conversation log.

  • Train and assist supervision of new Loan Processors and other processing personnel.

  • Assist closing, secondary marketing, and loan servicing to obtain and clear outstanding suspense items from CrossCountry Mortgage investors.

  • Available to work varying hours and overtime if needed.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.

  • Minimum of 5 years’ residential mortgage processing experience.

  • Experience with Encompass.

  • Working knowledge of RESPA regulations and general knowledge of all mortgage and consumer lending regulations, including but not limited to Regulation Z and Regulation B requirements, and loan documents, preferred.

  • Knowledge of DU, LP, Microsoft Office, and Windows.

  • Excellent math and analytical skills.

  • Excellent communication skills.

  • Excellent prioritization and time management skills.

Design Enterprise Solutions. Build Executive Confidence.

At Introhive, we believe technical excellence and trusted relationships are the foundation of enterprise success. As a Principal Client Solutions Architect, you'll serve as the senior technical and solution authority for our most strategic customer and prospect engagements.

This senior client-facing role sits at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and measurable value. Occasional travel may be required for customer meetings, workshops, industry events, and internal team engagements.

  • Translate complex business and technical requirements into clear solution designs and implementation guidance.
  • Facilitate executive workshops that build trust, reduce risk, and accelerate decision-making.

Success in this role is measured by your ability to:

  • Build executive trust through strategic technical leadership.
  • Move customers confidently from technical discovery to implementation.
  • Deliver clear solution designs that minimize implementation risk.
  • Resolve privacy, security, and integration challenges early in the sales cycle.
  • Help customers realize measurable business value quickly.
  • Elevate the technical capabilities and consulting standards of the Solutions Consulting organization.

  • 10+ years of experience, with at least 5 years focused on enterprise-scale B2B SaaS architecture or strategic pre-sales.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Customer-Centric Mindset

  • Executive Presence

What you'll do:

You will directly manage and mentor a team of BSA/AML analysts responsible for a range of activities including customer onboarding, transaction monitoring, investigations, and SAR filings. You will help foster a culture of compliance and continuous improvement within the Bank, while playing a key role in developing and maintaining processes and controls that align with the Bank’s risk tolerance, while partnering with BaaS customers to ensure their BSA/AML Programs align with the Bank’s standards.
  • Directly manage the team responsible for manually reviewing customer onboarding applications that are not automatically approved
  • Oversee the manual review process to ensure all necessary customer due diligence (CDD) is performed accurately and thoroughly
  • Make final decisions on these manually reviewed applications, determining whether to approve or deny the customer relationship based on the bank's risk policies
  • Maintain and regularly review the bank's high-risk customer list
  • Ensure that Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) is conducted on all high-risk customers at least annually
  • Manage and oversee the investigation and review of activity for all high-risk customers, documenting findings and making recommendations for account status changes
  • Directly manage the team of BSA/AML analysts responsible for monitoring transactions and reviewing system-generated alerts

  • Collaborate with BaaS partners to ensure their internal controls and BSA/AML programs align with the bank's risk policies
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all law enforcement requests, including subpoenas and search warrants

  • Proven experience managing or leading a team of compliance professionals
  • Expert knowledge of BSA, AML, and OFAC regulations
  • Hands-on experience with BSA/AML monitoring systems and case management
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and decision-making skills
  • CAMS certification is strongly preferred

raw.description:
Job Description:

Who we are:

We’re Cart.com, one of the fastest growing commerce enablement companies in the world. We provide the digital and physical infrastructure that empowers thousands of leading B2C, B2B and public sector organizations to unify commerce operations from product discovery to product delivery.

We’re building toward a world where commerce has no bounds. Our enterprise-grade software, services and logistics infrastructure, including our own network of omnichannel fulfillment and distribution centers, enable merchants to navigate an increasingly complex operating landscape and drive efficient growth.

Our goal is to be the global backbone of commerce. To achieve it, we’re looking for entrepreneurial, innovative and determined teammates who are eager to help our growing base of customers simplify their commerce operations and seamlessly reach their own customers, wherever they are. Sound like you? We’d love to hear from you.

Cart.com Fast Facts:

  • 6,000+ customers worldwide
  • 1,600+ employees globally
  • 17 warehouses nationwide, totaling over 10 million square feet of space
  • Headquartered in Houston, TX with international offices in Mexico and Poland

Our values:

Cart.com is building a company that is committed to living out these 6 core values:

  • Be brand obsessed: Our lives are shaped by the brands we interact with daily. We obsess over the brands we serve, and about the things they care about.
  • Think beyond the box: “We’ve always done it that way” is not a phrase uttered often at our office. We create creative solutions to complex problems.
  • Don’t give up: We learn from our challenges and see them for what they are; great building blocks to an amazing brand story.
  • Speak up: We communicate clearly and directly because we care deeply. Communication is the bedrock of our community.
  • Work together: We’ve built a team that prides itself on diversity of thought and background. Collaboration is better with contrast.
  • Remember to be human: We work hard, but we leave room for the people, places and things that we love.

The Role:  

As the Accounts Payable Manager at Cart.com, you will play a critical role in ensuring the accuracy and efficiency of our payment processes. You will lead a dynamic team responsible for managing all aspects of the accounts payable function, including processing invoices, ensuring timely payments, and maintaining strong relationships with vendors. Your ability to drive process improvements, ensure compliance, and provide strategic insights will be essential to the financial health and operational success of the company.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape and optimize our AP processes, working closely with cross-functional teams to support our fast-growing business. You will be a key player in our finance department, overseeing AP month-end close activities and preparing for internal and external audits. Your leadership will be instrumental in building a high-performing AP team that thrives on accuracy, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

If you are a detail-oriented, strategic thinker with a passion for process optimization and team leadership, this is an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact at a rapidly growing e-commerce company.

What You’ll Do:

  • Manage the AP Function: Oversee the entire accounts payable process, including invoice processing, payment execution, credit applications, vendor management, and reconciliation of accounts.

  • Lead and Mentor the AP Team: Supervise a team of three to four AP associates, providing guidance, training, and performance feedback to ensure high standards of accuracy and efficiency.

  • Ensure Compliance:Monitor and ensure compliance with company policies, tax regulations, and accounting standards, including W-9 and 1099 reporting.

  • Process Improvement:Identify, recommend, and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of the AP function, including automation and system enhancements.

  • Vendor Relations: Develop and maintain strong relationships with vendors, resolving any issues related to invoicing, payments, or discrepancies in a timely and professional manner.

  • Month-End Close: Support the monthly financial close process by preparing AP-related reconciliations, accruals, and reports, ensuring all AP transactions are accurately recorded.

  • Data Analysis and Reporting: Prepare and analyze AP reports, providing insights and recommendations to senior management on cash flow, payment cycles, and vendor performance.

  • System Management: Collaborate with IT and finance teams to maintain and improve AP systems (e.g., Bill.com, Microsoft Dynamics), ensuring they meet the needs of the business.

  • Audit Preparation: Prepare for and support internal and external audits by providing accurate documentation and reports related to the AP function.

  • Training and Documentation: Develop training materials and standard operating procedures for the AP team, ensuring consistency and compliance across the department.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with other departments, including procurement, finance, and operations, to streamline processes and support overall business objectives.

Who You Are:

  • Detail-Oriented and Accurate: You have an exceptional eye for detail and prioritize accuracy in all aspects of your work, ensuring the integrity of financial data.

  • Strong Leader: You possess strong leadership skills with the ability to effectively manage, mentor, and motivate a team, fostering a high-performance culture.

  • Process-Oriented: You are adept at developing and refining processes to improve efficiency, reduce errors, and ensure timely payment processing.

  • Proactive Problem Solver: You anticipate challenges and take the initiative to address issues before they escalate, implementing solutions that enhance overall performance.

  • Excellent Communicator: You communicate clearly and effectively, whether it's collaborating with your team, liaising with vendors, or reporting to senior management.

  • Analytical and Strategic: You think critically and strategically, using data to drive decisions and improvements in the AP process.

  • Highly Organized: You are skilled at managing multiple priorities, maintaining organization in a fast-paced environment, and ensuring deadlines are consistently met.

  • Tech-Savvy: You are comfortable working with various accounting and AP systems, quickly adapting to new technologies and tools.

  • Integrity and Confidentiality: You handle all financial data with the utmost integrity and maintain strict confidentiality.

What You’ve Done:

  • 6+ Years of Accounts Payable Experience: Proven experience in managing AP functions, including vendor management, invoice processing, and payment execution.

  • Supervisory Experience:Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor an AP team, ensuring high performance and adherence to deadlines.

  • Experience in High-Growth Environments: Comfortable working in fast-paced, high-growth companies, ideally in the e-commerce or technology sector.

  • Strong Knowledge of AP Systems: Proficient in AP tools such as Bill.com, Microsoft Dynamics, and other ERP systems.

  • Advanced Excel Skills:Expertise in Excel, including VLOOKUP, pivot tables, and complex data analysis.

  • Process Improvement Mindset: Proven track record of identifying and implementing process improvements to enhance efficiency and accuracy.

  • Knowledge of Tax Compliance: Familiarity with tax regulations related to AP, including W-9 and 1099 reporting.

  • Experience with Automation Tools: Experience implementing or working with automation tools to streamline AP processes.

  • Project Management Experience: Ability to manage AP-related projects, including system upgrades or process overhauls.

Nice to Haves: 

  • CPA or Relevant Certification: Professional certification such as CPA or CMA is a plus, demonstrating a deep understanding of financial principles.

  • Experience with Multi-Entity Organizations: Experience managing AP for multi-entity or multi-location businesses.

  • Experience with Automation Tools: Experience implementing or working with automation tools to streamline AP processes.

  • Familiarity with International Payments: Experience managing AP processes involving international vendors and currencies.


Currently, Cart.com does not intend to hire candidates who will need, now or in the future, Cart.com sponsorship through any non-immigrant visa category such as the H-1B, H-1B1, E-3, O-1, or TN.

All hiring is contingent on eligibility to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or transfer visas for applicants.

Cart.com is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Job Title: Vaccines Specialist, Health and Science Professional - Midland, TX

Job Location: United States - Texas - Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

ROLE SUMMARY

Everything we do, every day, is in line with an unwavering commitment to the quality and the delivery of safe and effective products to patients. Our science and risk-based compliant quality culture is innovative and customer oriented. Whether you are involved in manufacturing, testing, or compliance, your contribution will directly impact patients.

All over the world, Pfizer colleagues work together to positively impact health for everyone, everywhere. Our colleagues have the opportunity to grow and develop a career that offers both individual and company success; be part of an ownership culture that values diversity and where all colleagues are energized and engaged; and the ability to impact the health and lives of millions of people. Pfizer, a global leader in the biopharmaceutical industry, is continuously seeking top talent who are inspired by our purpose to innovate to bring therapies to patients that significantly improve their lives.

The Vaccines Health and Science Professional (HSP) is responsible for the promotion of a Vaccines Portfolio across customers and channels. This position will require regular live in field customer engagement in addition to virtual engagements.

The HSP is accountable for launching new products, deciding upon the best strategies to manage business relationships, understanding, and securing formulary access, and engaging in product promotion within the assigned geography. In addition, the HSP is charged with sales efforts and relationship development with customers and accounts, including Therapeutic Area Specialists, and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).

The HSP should possess customer, market and business acumen combined with strong product and disease state knowledge; demonstrate strong sales, strategic business development, account management skills and in-depth customer engagement expertise in both virtual and in-person settings; utilize a systematic approach to virtual engagement (e.g., clear agenda, next steps/follow ups); have outstanding communications skills; be adept in the operation of digital and virtual tools/multi-platforms skills. Effective at working remotely in collaboration with cross-functional internal teams to address customer needs and compliantly deliver on Pfizer business objectives.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Drive sales in assigned territory to maximize approved business objectives

  • Engages with customers both face to face and virtually

  • Develops and implements effective business and territory call plans; effectively identifies and implements live/virtual engagement strategies with customer to maximize overall effectiveness and impact

  • Effectively builds rapport and relationships with customers in both live and virtual environments; uses judgment to maintain customer engagement by successfully utilizing existing and ever-changing digital tools effectively for successful customer engagement

  • Understands and leverages internal reports and analytics to assist with identifying, developing, and implementing strategic business opportunities

  • Compliantly leverages product and disease state knowledge using approved clinically oriented disease state information and patient resources, as applicable

  • Demonstrates market knowledge, uncovering barriers and drivers across all relevant business channels (Public Health, Private Market, Retail, etc.)

  • Collaborate effectively and compliantly with cross-functional colleagues, including Field Medical and Account Management, to address customer inquiries and advance Pfizer objectives

  • Completes all administrative expectations on time and compliantly (e.g., entering customer calls appropriately, submitting expenses, responding to all requests from sales leadership, managers and/or Pfizer internal partners)

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s Degree

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in one or more of the following OR an associate’s degree with 6+ years of experience; OR high school diploma (or equivalent) with 8+ years of relevant experience:

  • Professional Sales or Promotional Activity

  • Small Business Owner or other Entrepreneurial experience, Marketing, Customer Service and/or Account Management

  • Relevant Healthcare/Scientific roles (e.g., RN, Pharmacist, PT, OT, etc.)

  • Educator (e.g., Teacher, Principal)

  • Full time Military experience

  • Must live within 25 miles of the border of the territory

  • Valid US driver’s license and driving record in compliance with company standards. Any DUI/DWI or other impaired driving citation within the past 7 years will disqualify you from being hired.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 1 year of pharmaceutical, biotech, medical sales and/or medical related marketing

  • Strong track record of sales or marketing success, strong territory management skills, outstanding communications skills, as well as demonstrated teamwork, leadership ability and accountability

  • Experience with Vaccines therapeutic area and products

  • Knowledge of posted territory customers and markets (prescribers/HCPs/institutions/organizations)

  • Reside within the territory boundaries

Other Job Details:

Last Date to Apply: August 20, 2026

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $76,000 - $199,600. During initial new hire sales training, you will be classified as a salary non-exempt employee which entitles you to overtime pay. Upon your training certification, you will become an overtime exempt employee. In addition, this position offers an additional quarterly Sales Incentive bonus. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits| (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. The United States salary range provided does not apply to any location outside of the United States.

Relocation assistance may be available based on business needs and/or eligibility.

Candidates must be authorized to be employed in the U.S. by any employer.

U.S. work visa sponsorship (such as TN, O-1, H-1B, etc.) is not available for this role now or in the future.

Sunshine Act

Pfizer reports payments and other transfers of value to health care providers as required by federal and state transparency laws and implementing regulations. These laws and regulations require Pfizer to provide government agencies with information such as a health care provider’s name, address and the type of payments or other value received, generally for public disclosure. Subject to further legal review and statutory or regulatory clarification, which Pfizer intends to pursue, reimbursement of recruiting expenses for licensed physicians may constitute a reportable transfer of value under the federal transparency law commonly known as the Sunshine Act. Therefore, if you are a licensed physician who incurs recruiting expenses as a result of interviewing with Pfizer that we pay or reimburse, your name, address and the amount of payments made currently will be reported to the government. If you have questions regarding this matter, please do not hesitate to contact your Talent Acquisition representative.

EEO & Employment Eligibility

Pfizer is committed to equal opportunity in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status. Pfizer also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. Pfizer is an E-Verify employer. This position requires permanent work authorization in the United States.

raw.description:
Company Overview: Terray Therapeutics is a venture-backed biotechnology company led by pioneers and long-time leaders in artificial intelligence, synthetic chemistry, automation, and nanotechnology. We’re generating chemical data purpose-built to propel drug discovery into the information age — and we’re doing it on a larger scale and faster than has ever before been possible.

Our closed loop system generates precise chemical datasets at unrivaled scale that work seamlessly with AI to systematically map biochemical interactions between small molecules and causes of disease. Iterative cycles of virtual molecular design and experimentation power AI and machine learning models, which in turn guide the next cycle of design. With a chemistry engine that measures billions of interactions daily and becomes increasingly precise with every cycle, we can answer an unprecedented array of questions — deriving insights that enable us to predictably create drugs for patients in need.

Position Summary: Terray Therapeutics is seeking an Associate Director, Product Management to lead the product vision and execution for tDesign – an internal platform that serves as the central interface for our small molecule drug discovery programs. Reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer, this is a highly visible role where you will operate at the strategic center of the company, influencing how our science and technology converge to solve complex problems. You will empower our medicinal chemists and molecular design scientists by giving them intuitive access to our proprietary AI models through automated workflows and drug discovery agents. Concurrently, you will work with our ML engineers, software engineers, and other computational scientists to translate complex drug discovery needs into a seamless user experience that accelerates our ability to find novel cures.

The core responsibilities of this position are:

  • Strategic Product Leadership: Own the product lifecycle for tDesign, defining a roadmap that aligns with Terray’s high-level scientific and business goals. You will present regularly to executive leadership and key stakeholders on product impact and strategy.
  • User-Centric Design: Deeply understand the workflows of medicinal chemists, molecular design scientists, and small molecule program leads to improve and build features that solve real friction points in the design-make-test-analyze (DMTA) cycle. Translate complex internal scientific tools into intuitive, resilient user experiences suitable for broader deployment beyond the original development context.
  • Cross-Functional Orchestration: Act as the primary bridge between our scientific stakeholders and our engineering/AI teams. Partner with scientific stakeholders to ensure technical specifications accurately translate and support biological and chemical realities and drive alignment across the organization.
  • Agent & Workflow Integration: Lead the integration of new AI agents and automated workflows into the UI, making advanced computational tools accessible to non-computational experts.
  • Adoption & Efficacy: Monitor user engagement and program success metrics to continuously iterate on the platform. Apply SaaS product principles to ensure tDesign remains the "command center" for all small molecule programs.

Experience and Qualifications: Part of Terray’s success is nurtured by a hands-on work environment where everyone is accountable, vested in a vision of excellence, and actively taking part in the success of the business. Terray supports a positive work environment where employees can feel engaged, recognized and empowered to be creative.

Required Qualifications:

  • Software Product Excellence: Proven experience (5+ years) managing complex, high-technical software products in a tech-first, SaaS, or high-growth environment. We value strong product fundamentals (discovery, definition, execution) over specific life sciences domain expertise.
  • Internal Tools Experience: Demonstrated success building and managing complex internal tools or platforms used by highly technical teams.
  • Technical Fluency: Ability to grasp complex AI/ML/computational concepts and translate them into user-facing features (e.g., visualizing model confidence, managing inference workflows).
  • Execution Focus: A track record of shipping highly reliable, robust software in an agile environment, balancing long-term vision with immediate scientific needs.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Enterprise Product Expansion: Experience transitioning complex internal tools into external-facing enterprise products, including scoping requirements, defining SLAs, and managing expectations for sophisticated external clients (such as large pharmaceutical or enterprise partners).
  • Secure Infrastructure & Deployment: Proven ability to partner closely with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and DevOps teams to architect and deliver highly available software. Familiarity with the technical and operational nuances of deploying applications into diverse, secure, or client-hosted cloud environments (e.g., secure VPCs).
  • Data Governance & Security: Deep understanding of best practices surrounding data privacy, security, and enterprise governance, specifically concerning the ingestion, segregation, and management of highly sensitive, proprietary third-party datasets.
  • Long-Term Product Strategy: The ability to balance the immediate, fast-paced needs of internal scientific stakeholders with the architectural and UX requirements needed to eventually support a broader, external user base.

Compensation Details: $195,000 - $294,000 (annually) depending on experience; participation in the Company's option plan; 3% retirement safe harbor contribution; fully-paid medical, dental, vision, life and disability benefits; and much more.

The Mission: Transforming Businesses for the AI Age

Many businesses still depend on disconnected software, spreadsheets, manual processes, and knowledge trapped inside individual employees’ heads. Lumion brings those systems and processes together so organizations can operate more intelligently and efficiently.

We are starting with trade and technical schools. Our platform powers the entire institution, from the first lead through enrollment, tuition payments, compliance reporting, graduation, and career tracking.

These schools prepare electricians, welders, nurses, technicians, and other skilled professionals who keep the country moving. By modernizing their operations, Lumion helps them serve more students and strengthen the skilled workforce.

The Opportunity: Learn How Software Will Be Built in the Future

This is a place to launch your career at the cutting edge of software development. You will learn how coding will be done in the future and become part of the wave changing how software is created.

Our stack and development processes are AI First. Claude Code and Codex are part of our normal workflow, with access to the latest frontier models without having to ration tokens or worry about usage limits. You will learn the workflows, judgment, and verification practices required to use these systems effectively and become a 100x developer.

Working at a startup also gives you the opportunity to wear different hats and see problems from engineering, product, customer, and business perspectives. You will gain experience that is difficult to find when working inside one narrow area of a larger company.

If you want a fast moving environment, the excitement of solving new problems, and the chance to look back proudly on helping build something significant, this is that opportunity.

The Role: Code at the Speed of Thought

Your work will span backend business logic, data models, APIs, integrations, administrative workflows, customer facing interfaces, and automated tests.

You will be a full member of the engineering team from day one and trusted with meaningful production work. Important assignments are not reserved for people with longer résumés. You will be held to the same standards for quality, communication, and follow through as every other engineer at Lumion.

What We’re Looking For

Professional software engineering experience is not required.

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science is required. The degree must be completed before your employment begins. Current students may apply if they will graduate before their start date.

  • Evidence that you have put your programming skills into practice. This can come from a capstone, internship, personal project, open source contribution, research project, freelance engagement, or another hands on project. We want to understand what you worked on, what you personally contributed, and what you learned.

  • Confidence in at least one programming language. You can build with it, debug it, and explain the logic behind your decisions. The language does not need to be PHP, and prior Laravel experience is not required.

  • An understanding of web development fundamentals. You are familiar with concepts such as HTTP, APIs, authentication, databases, browser interfaces, version control, and automated testing.

  • Logical problem solving. You can break an unfamiliar problem into manageable parts, investigate failures systematically, and work toward the underlying cause.

  • Product judgment. You consider the person using the software and connect technical decisions to the problem being solved.

How We Work

Lumion is a high trust team. We share context openly, keep our egos low, raise risks early, and ask questions when something does not make sense.

To show that you read the entire posting, tell us in your application what you would do with a golden banana. There are no wrong answers except not answering.

The Stack

Our current application stack includes:

  • Application: PHP 8.4+, Laravel 12+, Livewire, Filament, Blade, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS

  • Data: MySQL, Redis, pgvector, and Pinecone

  • Testing: Pest PHP

Why Join Lumion Now?

Lumion closed a $10.7 million seed round backed by TTV Capital and Tusk Venture Partners. More than 400 career schools use our platform to support over 150,000 students across 48 states and 29 industries.

Schools using Lumion see 47% more completed applications, a 73.6% application to enrollment rate, 91% on time tuition collection, and 21% higher student retention.

We have the capital and momentum to build something that lasts while remaining early enough for every engineer to influence the product and company.

Remote First

This is a full time remote position. You must reside in and be authorized to work in the United States. Your normal workday must overlap by at least six hours with our Salt Lake City team.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Salary: $80,000 to $100,000 USD

Senior Client Operations Manager

Summary of Position:

The Senior Manager, Client Operations is a senior-level operational and client leader responsible for the performance, stability, and growth of assigned client accounts. This role serves as a bridge between operational execution and strategic leadership, combining hands-on oversight of client operations with increasing accountability for people leadership, financial performance, client retention, and revenue growth. The Senior Manager monitors operational efficiencies through reporting, partners closely with Directors to identify and communicate inefficiencies, and implements timely corrective actions to ensure accounts remain in strong financial and operational standing. While primarily a remote position, travel to client accounts is required when gaps in processes, protocols, or gross margins are identified or when an account is deemed at risk.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Own the day-to-day operational performance of assigned client accounts to ensure stability, quality, and achievement of monthly revenue goals
  • Monitor operational efficiency through reporting and analysis of productivity, quality, and financial performance metrics
  • Analyze reports and performance data to identify trends, gaps, risks, and opportunities impacting account performance
  • Partner with Directors and Client Managers to communicate identified inefficiencies and implement timely corrective actions
  • Support Directors and Client Managers in managing accounts based on gaps and trends identified through reporting
  • Identify and recommend opportunities to improve productivity, increase efficiency, and support revenue growth
  • Assist Client Managers in developing and executing effective action plans to capture all areas of opportunity within their book of business
  • Prepare, analyze, and present standardized weekly dashboards, month-end operational performance reports, and ad-hoc reporting, as required
  • Provide reporting and metrics support for assigned client accounts
  • Attend monthly P&L meetings with Directors to understand financial performance, identify gaps, and support corrective strategies
  • Translate operational and financial metrics into actionable recommendations to support leadership decision-making
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for routine client communication and maintain strong, professional relationships with client management teams
  • Lead and continuously improve Client Manager and Supervisor meetings to review performance, align priorities, support operational alignment, and drive accountability
  • Provide leadership, coaching, and guidance to supervisors, managers and team members
  • Support hiring, onboarding, training, implementation, and ongoing performance management activities
  • Ensure appropriate staffing coverage, workforce alignment, and payroll review to support operational needs
  • Provide implementation and training support during the onboarding of new business to ensure consistency in processes and reporting
  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA, ROI regulations, contractual obligations, and Verisma policies and procedures
  • Review release of information requests for validity in accordance with applicable state and federal statutes
  • Perform quality reviews and audits as required by Verisma and client agreements
  • Monitor productivity and quality to ensure high levels of customer service satisfaction
  • Evaluate site protocols and best practices and provide input into the review and revision of procedures
  • Assist in the development and documentation of workflows that may be shared company-wide as best practices
  • Utilize Excel and business intelligence tools to generate analytical reports for clients, Directors, and executive leadership
