  • Experience with medical records or healthcare and knowledge of HIPAA privacy information standards, required
  • Familiarity with medical terminology, preferred
  • Experience with Excel and analytical databases to provide data reports to clients and executive leadership
  • Ability to report to work consistently with minimal unplanned schedule deviations
  • Live within a geographical area that is nearby or central to existing client business
  • Willing to travel to various assigned accounts and team meetings, as needed
  • A valid driver’s license and a history of safe driving

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Our client is looking for aBilling/Credentialing Specialistto support medical billing operations, provider enrollment, credentialing, and payer-related processes within a growing virtual healthcare organization. They operate in the telehealth and remote care industry and have recently expanded technology-enabled programs that have produced measurable improvements in patient monitoring, care coordination, and hospital readmission outcomes.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with U.S. healthcare billing and provider credentialing, understands how to navigate insurance and government payer requirements, and can maintain accurate documentation across multiple systems. Experience using Athenahealth EMR is strongly preferred.

Responsibilities
  • Manage medical billing activities, including claim creation, review, submission, and follow-up.
  • Verify that claims contain accurate patient, provider, insurance, coding, and service information before submission.
  • Monitor rejected and denied claims, identify the reason for nonpayment, and coordinate timely corrections or appeals.
  • Follow up on outstanding accounts receivable and unresolved claims with insurance carriers.
  • Post insurance and patient payments accurately within the billing or electronic medical record system.
  • Review explanation of benefits and electronic remittance information to identify adjustments, underpayments, and denials.
  • Confirm patient eligibility, insurance coverage, and authorization requirements when needed.
  • Maintain accurate billing documentation and update account notes after each follow-up action.
  • Coordinate the complete provider credentialing and recredentialing process.
  • Prepare, submit, and monitor provider enrollment applications with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance plans.
  • Maintain accurate provider information in credentialing databases and payer portals.
  • Update and manage provider profiles through platforms such as CAQH, PECOS, and NPPES.
  • Gather licenses, certifications, education records, insurance documentation, work history, and other supporting materials required for credentialing.
  • Track application deadlines, expirations, renewals, and outstanding payer requests.
  • Follow up with insurance carriers and credentialing organizations regarding application status and missing information.
  • Maintain organized and audit-ready credentialing records.
  • Communicate clearly with providers, internal team members, insurance representatives, and external partners.
  • Protect patient and provider information in accordance with HIPAA and organizational privacy standards.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in medical billing, provider credentialing, provider enrollment, or a closely related U.S. healthcare function.
  • Working knowledge of the U.S. healthcare reimbursement process.
  • Experience submitting and following up on claims with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance carriers.
  • Understanding of claim denials, payment posting, accounts receivable follow-up, and insurance verification.
  • Familiarity with provider enrollment, credentialing, and recredentialing processes.
  • Ability to manage confidential patient and provider information in accordance with HIPAA requirements.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify incomplete, inconsistent, or inaccurate information.
  • Excellent organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple applications, deadlines, and follow-up activities simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining consistent communication and accountability.
  • Reliable internet connection and a professional remote workspace.

Qualifications
  • Previous experience using the Athenahealth, AthenaOne EMR platform is required.
  • Experience with CAQH, PECOS, NPPES, Medicare enrollment systems, and commercial payer portals is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS, modifiers, and common medical billing terminology is an advantage.
  • Experience supporting telehealth, remote patient monitoring, chronic care management, transitional care management, or physician practices is preferred.
  • Knowledge of electronic claims, electronic remittance advice, clearinghouses, and payer-specific billing requirements is beneficial.

Benefits

  • Full-time position.
  • 100% remote opportunity for professionals located in LATAM.
  • Long-term opportunity within a growing virtual healthcare organization.
  • Exposure to both revenue cycle and provider credentialing operations.
  • Opportunity to contribute to processes that support better patient access and continuity of care.

You will establish the governance, security, engineering practices, and scalable architecture that will support the next generation of analytics and AI-enabled decision making. This role is more than leading Business Intelligence—it is about building a data-driven culture. You will champion enterprise self-service analytics, empower business users with trusted and governed data, and serve as Penn Foster Group's thought leader for Business Intelligence, analytics innovation, and data strategy. A key measure of success will be increasing enterprise adoption of self-service analytics while significantly reducing manual and ad hoc reporting requests. Working closely with executive leadership, Product Management, Data Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, and business stakeholders, you will shape Penn Foster Group's technology vision while mentoring and developing the next generation of Business Intelligence professionals.

Why Join Penn Foster?

This is an opportunity to:

  • Lead Penn Foster Group's transformation to a self-service analytics organization.
  • Shape the future architecture of our modern data, analytics, and AI platform.
  • Influence enterprise technology strategy and Business Intelligence standards.
  • Build and mentor a growing Business Intelligence team.
  • Work with modern technologies including Databricks, Power BI, Tableau, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, and cloud analytics platforms.
  • Deliver measurable business impact by increasing data literacy, enabling self-service analytics, and accelerating data-driven decision making across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities Business Intelligence Strategy & Self-Service Analytics

  • Lead the enterprise Business Intelligence strategy, architecture, and roadmap with a focus on expanding self-service analytics capabilities.
  • Champion adoption of self-service analytics by establishing governance, certified datasets, reusable semantic models, and enterprise reporting standards.
  • Develop and execute an enterprise adoption strategy that empowers business users to independently access trusted data and insights while reducing reliance on manual reporting and ad hoc requests.
  • Serve as Penn Foster Group's Business Intelligence thought leader by evaluating emerging technologies, AI capabilities, and industry best practices.
  • Establish KPIs that measure self-service adoption, platform utilization, analytics maturity, and business value.

Enterprise BI Architecture & Engineering

  • Architect and implement enterprise Business Intelligence solutions using Power BI, Tableau, SAP BusinessObjects, and Databricks.
  • Design scalable semantic models, enterprise data models, and governed reporting solutions supporting self-service analytics.
  • Define enterprise standards for architecture, security, governance, visualization, and performance optimization.
  • Serve as the Business Intelligence subject matter expert for the organization's Databricks Lakehouse platform, partnering with Data Engineering to deliver modern analytics solutions.
  • Design and implement enterprise security utilizing Row-Level Security (RLS), Object-Level Security (OLS), and governance best practices.
  • Partner with Data Engineering to optimize ETL/ELT processes, curated datasets, and enterprise reporting models.
  • Lead modernization initiatives including migration from legacy reporting platforms and adoption of emerging cloud and AI technologies.

Engineering Excellence & Delivery

  • Establish DevOps and CI/CD standards utilizing Azure DevOps, Git, source control, automated deployments, and release management.
  • Lead Business Intelligence initiatives within a fast-paced Agile environment using Jira and Scrum methodologies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Mentor and develop Business Intelligence Analysts and Developers through technical leadership, architecture reviews, coaching, and knowledge sharing.
  • Partner with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to align analytics initiatives with strategic business priorities.

Required Qualifications Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Data Warehousing, or Enterprise Reporting.
  • Minimum 3 years of technical leadership experience leading enterprise Business Intelligence initiatives or teams.

Technical Expertise

Expert-level experience with:

  • Microsoft Power BI
  • Tableau
  • SAP BusinessObjects
  • Databricks (Delta Lake, SQL Warehouses, Unity Catalog, Lakehouse Architecture)
  • SQL, enterprise data modeling, semantic modeling, and data warehousing
  • Business Intelligence architecture, governance, and enterprise security (RLS/OLS)
  • ETL/ELT processes and cloud analytics platforms
  • Azure DevOps, Git, DevOps, and CI/CD pipeline implementation
  • Performance optimization for enterprise reporting solutions

Leadership & Business Skills

  • Proven success implementing enterprise self-service analytics programs that drive adoption and reduce manual reporting.
  • Demonstrated experience leading organizational change and championing a data-driven culture.
  • Experience establishing Business Intelligence governance, Centers of Excellence, and enterprise best practices.
  • Demonstrated success mentoring Business Intelligence Analysts and technical teams.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced Agile environment using Jira and modern Scrum practices.
  • Exceptional communication, collaboration, strategic thinking, and executive presentation skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across all levels of the organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Analytics, or related field.
  • Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, Databricks, or SAP BusinessObjects certifications.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Alation, or other modern cloud data governance and analytics platforms.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be demonstrated by:

  • Successfully leading Penn Foster Group's transformation to a self-service analytics organization.
  • Increasing enterprise adoption and active usage of Business Intelligence platforms and governed self-service analytics.
  • Significantly reducing ad hoc reporting requests by enabling business users to independently access trusted data and insights.
  • Establishing scalable Business Intelligence architecture, governance, security, and DevOps standards that support future AI and analytics initiatives.
  • Delivering secure, high-performing analytics solutions that accelerate business decision making.
  • Building and mentoring a high-performing Business Intelligence team while fostering technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Work Environment & Hiring Requirements

  • Role Assessment: Candidates will be required to complete a role-specific assessment as the first step in the hiring process. Assessment results will be used to evaluate alignment with the position and determine next steps in the process.
  • Recorded Video Interviews: All video interviews conducted during the hiring process will be recorded to support internal hiring consistency and process improvement.
  • Background Checks: Employment with Penn Foster Group is contingent upon successfully completing applicable pre-employment screening requirements, which may include verification of employment history, education, and criminal background, where permitted by law.
  • Identity Verification (Form I-9): As part of our onboarding process, all hires must complete employment eligibility verification in compliance with federal law. This includes remote Form I-9 verification, which may require an in-person identity verification step with an authorized representative.
  • On-Camera Work Environment: We operate in a highly collaborative, remote, on-camera culture when working remotely. Employees are expected to be on camera during meetings unless extenuating circumstances apply.

About Us: At Penn Foster Group, we are transforming online learning to help learners by uniting Penn Foster, CareerStep, Ashworth College, James Madison High School, the New York Institute of Photography, the New York Institute of Art and Design, and other education platforms. Together, we create an accelerated path to greater economic mobility through real-world skills and knowledge that enable them to achieve long-term success in the workplaces of the future. Our history dates back to 1890 when our founder, Thomas Foster, pioneered distance education by offering training by mail for coal miners to get the necessary skills for safer jobs. Today, with the partners who use our education and training programs, we continue that mission of providing accessible training and education for in-demand skills and are building a workforce that’s prepared for the future job market. Equal Employment Opportunity: We strive toward Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Penn Foster Group by intentionally building teams that are diverse – in identities, lived experiences, and ideas to create a culture where people feel connected to each other and have a sense of belonging. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion because it is the foundation that enables us to achieve what we set out to do as an organization – from maximizing the number of learners who can reach their goals while giving them the kinds of experiences we want them to have, to becoming the type of company we want to work in. What We Offer: We offer a robust benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, flexible spending, generous paid time off, sponsored volunteer opportunities, a 401K with a company match, plus free access to all of our online programs.

Technology Production Supervisor

Position Summary

Technology Production is the layer where client work becomes reliable, repeatable, and scalable — the emails, banners, landing pages, websites, custom applications, and client-specific product implementations our pharma clients depend on. The Technology Production Supervisor is the hands-on technical leader who runs that production day to day.

This is a technical role, not a project management role. You will work closely with project managers and with every department — creative, product engineering, platform, marketing ops, and account teams — but your value is technical: guiding developers, reviewing work, translating ambiguous requests into clear technical requirements, keeping delivery on track, and being the person the team and clients turn to when something needs to get built or fixed. It is the kind of hands-on technical leadership the function's senior developers provide today.

Key Responsibilities

•Be the SME on everything we produce. Serve as the subject-matter expert on all Technology Production deliverables and products — emails, banners, EHR units, landing pages, WordPress/CMS, custom websites and applications, and our client-specific product implementations.

•Lead day-to-day technical delivery. Attend project kickoffs, scope work technically, and guide the development team from intake through build, QA, and delivery.

•Own allocation and resourcing. Decide who works on what, today — balancing a fast-moving agency pipeline where priorities shift and work arrives with little notice.

•Spot-check quality. Light-touch reviews to catch clearly broken things — not deep code audits. AI, automated tests, and QA increasingly cover this, and other developers can do deeper code reviews when needed; you set the quality bar and step in where it matters (e.g., regulated/MLR accuracy).

•Triage and resolve technical issues. Act as the first escalation point when something breaks across our sites or deliverables; unblock developers and answer their questions.

•Translate business needs into technical requirements. Because project managers are not technical, you bridge the gap — turning client and business requests into precise, buildable specs, and telling PMs and clients what's actually needed to get things done.

•Keep delivery on time. Track developer progress and timelines; flag and resolve risks before they become misses.

•Partner across departments. Coordinate with creative, product engineering, platform/tech-ops, marketing ops, and account teams; route work to the right place and keep hand-offs clean.

•Be a technical and client-facing partner. Represent Technology Production credibly to clients on technical matters.

•Drive automation and AI enablement. Contribute to runbooks and consistent process, and actively apply AI / agentic tools and automated workflows to make production faster, cheaper, and more reliable.

•Coordinate contractors and vendors. Oversee onshore/nearshore contract developers and keep vendor delivery on standard.

Success Measures

  • Demonstrates accountability for outcomes and deadlines
  • Builds strong internal and external partnerships
  • Adapts to change with professionalism and resilience
  • Delivers work aligned with quality, timeliness, and business impact

Required Qualifications

•Strong hands-on web development background — HTML, CSS, JavaScript and modern front-end; comfortable reading, reviewing, and debugging code. Full-stack experience is a strong plus.

•Experience producing the deliverable types we build: HTML emails, banners, landing pages, WordPress/CMS, and custom websites/applications.

•Experience leading or coordinating developers (or contractors), with the judgment to allocate work and keep a team on track.

•Ability to translate ambiguous, non-technical requests into clear technical requirements — and to communicate them to PMs, clients, and other departments.

•Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration; comfortable being client-facing.

•Strong attention to detail and QA discipline; able to hold work to regulated-content standards.

•Comfort with agency pace — shifting priorities, tight deadlines, and hands-on allocation.

•An AI-forward, agentic mindset — actively uses AI and agentic tools (ideally including local models) to speed and improve production, with the discipline to verify output for regulated work.

Preferred Qualifications

•Pharma / healthcare or other regulated-industry experience (MLR, ISI, job codes).

•Veeva (Approved Email / CLM) or comparable CRM/marketing-platform experience — or the appetite to own it.

•DevOps / CI experience and an automation mindset (scripting, AI-enabled workflows).

•Experience implementing client-specific instances of a product from a shared template/platform.

Work Environment

·Standard office or remote work environment – Based on Location

·May require occasional travel or extended hours during peak business periods

Relevate Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications

Candidates must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis without current or future employer sponsorship.

raw.description:
We’re hiring a Clinical Product Specialist to advance the usefulness and trustworthiness of Blueprint’s AI tools for mental health professionals.

Building AI for clinicians requires more than adding clinical review at the end of the product-development process. Clinical judgment must shape how problems are defined, how systems are designed, and how quality is measured. We're looking for someone who has actually done the work—sat with a client in acute risk and decided what to do next, chosen an intervention and adjusted it when it wasn't landing, managed a full week of sessions and everything that surrounds them—and who can bring that judgment directly into how our products get built. You’ll develop evaluation methods, improve AI behavior, identify failure modes, and help teams make thoughtful clinical, product, and business trade-offs.

This is not a traditional clinical-advisory position. You’ll work hands-on with AI systems while serving as a clinical expert among clinicians, product managers, designers, and engineers. You’ll turn nuanced clinical needs into clear product requirements and measurable quality standards, then help carry solutions from an ambiguous problem through a successful release.

What you’ll own

  • Define what clinically excellent AI output looks like for the product surfaces you support, translating clinical judgment into clear standards and measurable criteria. That typically includes designing and maintaining clinical evaluation suites, including representative test cases, scoring rubrics, benchmarks, and processes for identifying regressions
  • Ground those standards in evidence-based practice and real-world care delivery, for example how a clinician actually reasons through a case, selects and sequences interventions, responds and documents risk, and what a clinician needs in order to trust and act on what the product tells them
  • Work hands-on with prompts, models, and product workflows to improve quality, analyze failure modes, and determine when solutions are ready for customers
  • Set the clinical bar for how our products handle high-acuity content and define what appropriate handling looks like in an AI-assisted workflow
  • Contribute to ambiguous clinical-product initiatives from problem definition through a shippable plan, working alongside product, engineering, design, and other stakeholders on the right trade-offs to make
  • Partner directly with customers and clinical leaders to understand their workflows and concerns, translate their needs into product requirements, and build confidence in Blueprint’s approach
  • Contribute to clinical-quality methodology and reusable practices that raise the standard of AI product development across Blueprint

Who we’re looking for

  • You’re a licensed behavioral health clinician with direct-care experience and strong clinical judgment.
  • You’re fluent in evidence-based approaches such as CBT, ACT, DBT, and MI, and know how to select, adapt, and evaluate interventions.
  • You’ve practiced measurement-based care, using outcomes and progress data to guide treatment.
  • You have experience assessing clinical risk—including suicidality and higher-acuity presentations—and understand responsible documentation and escalation.
  • You understand how clinicians work in practice, from planning sessions and evolving treatment plans to managing caseloads and time pressure.
  • You’ve contributed to AI-enabled, digital health, or similarly technical clinical initiatives; experience with behavioral health documentation or workflows is especially valuable.
  • You’re comfortable evaluating and improving generative AI systems through prompt iteration, structured evaluation, output review, and failure-mode analysis.
  • You can translate clinical nuance into clear product requirements and measurable quality standards, partnering effectively with product managers and engineers.
  • You communicate credibly with clinical leaders and enterprise customers and explain product decisions with clarity and sound clinical reasoning.
  • You’re curious, analytical, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership amid early-stage ambiguity.

Training or applied experience in clinical research, program evaluation, or implementation science is a plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity
  • 100% remote – no office, no commuting
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance, with 75% of your premium covered by Blueprint
  • Semi-annual team gatherings (in Chicago!)
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Opportunities to grow with the company and shape our product
  • Hardworking, mission-driven, friendly coworkers

Blueprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for developing, implementing, and managing the execution of various specialized projects that support the achievement of multi-faceted organizational objectives. Additional responsibilities may include oversight of budgets, participation in plan development and direct or indirect reporting relationships depending on the project and functional area for which the incumbents reside. Incumbents in this role will partner with colleagues and management internal or external to the department to complete projects that streamline, enhance and/or integrate processes, procedures and actions that result in effective, efficient and/or compliant strategies and tactics.

JOB DESCRIPTION

  • Review and make recommendations on department or cross-departmental planning and design, may contribute in contract negotiations, providing project schedules and budget reporting to regional director.

  • Ensure any quality control measures or processes specific to the function are developed, implemented and/or conducted to ensure expectations are met.

raw.description:
As an Organic Standards Auditor, you will conduct on-site audits of organic operators across the United States, supporting certification activities in accordance with applicable organic standards and internal procedures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct on-site audits and inspections of organic operators, including farms, livestock operations, processors, handlers, and other relevant scopes.
  • Plan and prepare audits, including prior review of documentation, risk assessment, sampling definition, and preparation of standard-specific checklists.
  • Conduct interviews, facility and field inspections, document reviews, and evidence collection.
  • Verify traceability systems, mass balance records, input approvals, production records, and organic integrity controls.
  • Assess risks related to contamination, commingling, fraud, prohibited substances, and other risks to organic integrity.
  • Prepare clear, complete, accurate, and timely audit reports, including documentation of nonconformities and corrective action deadlines.
  • Review corrective action evidence and support the certification decision-making process in accordance with internal procedures.
  • Maintain up-to-date technical knowledge of regulatory changes, organic standards, and internal certification policies.
  • Act with professionalism, ethics, impartiality, confidentiality, and a strong commitment to quality.
  • Travel frequently within the assigned region and, when required, to other areas of the United States.
  • Demonstrated experience as an Organic Auditor, Inspector, or Certification Specialist, preferably under the USDA National Organic Program (USDA NOP).
  • Knowledge of additional organic standards or programs, such as EU Organic Regulation, Brazil Organic Regulation, Demeter, or Fair Trade, is a plus.
  • Practical experience conducting audits involving traceability, mass balance, input verification, record review, and risk assessment.
  • Experience identifying and evaluating risks related to contamination, commingling, labeling, fraud prevention, and organic integrity.
  • Ability to independently conduct audits and write high-quality technical reports in English.
  • Experience with one or more certification scopes, including:
    • Crop production
    • Livestock production
    • Wild crop harvesting
    • Processing and handling
    • Storage, distribution, and trading activities
  • Strong organizational, communication, and time-management skills.
  • Availability and willingness to travel extensively for field audits.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to travel domestically within the United States.
  • Technical degree, bachelor’s degree, or higher education in Agronomy, Agriculture, Animal Science, Veterinary Medicine, Food Science, Biology, Environmental Science, Sustainability, or a related field; equivalent proven experience in the organic sector or certification/audit activities will also be considered.
  • Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • This is a remote position; however, candidates must be based in one of the following hiring regions: East Coast, Midwest, or West Coast.

QIMA offers solutions for the food industry from farm to fork through GFSI-recognized certifications (PrimusGFS, GLOBALG.A.P., SQF, BRCGS, IFS), third- and second-party food safety audits, ethical audits, quality seals, inspections, training, and supply chain management. We have offices in Brazil, the United States, and Mexico, and a team of auditors in several countries. Since 2019, we have been part of the QIMA Group.

raw.description:
The Company

InvestX launched in 2014 and is a late-stage venture fund investing out of Fund 5. With over US$700 million in investments and 35+ portfolio companies including Palantir, Anthropic, SpaceX, Airbnb, SoFi, Spotify, DocuSign, and many more, we work with leading North American wealth management firms and family office clients to offer multi-position and single-purpose funds.

InvestX is backed by leading financial institutions including Jefferies, Virtu Financial, and Canaccord Genuity and has been featured in CNBC, Forbes, Bloomberg, U.S. News, Business Insider, Reuters, The Globe and Mail, and other leading publications.

About the Role

We are looking for a driven, high-energy Director, RIA Business Development to help expand InvestX's Registered Investment Advisor (RIA) distribution channel across the U.S.

This is a prospecting-first sales role for someone who gets energy from creating opportunities. You will spend a significant portion of your time identifying target RIAs, cold calling, executing outbound outreach, finding the right decision-makers, and turning new conversations into qualified meetings and opportunities.

Working closely with the Head of RIA Business Development, you will help build the top of the sales funnel and expand InvestX's reach within the independent wealth management market.

We're looking for a true hunter mentality. You are persistent, competitive, curious, and resourceful. You're comfortable picking up the phone, hearing "no," following up again, and finding another way into an account. You don't wait for opportunities to come to you—you create them.

Location: United States (Remote) or Hybrid (3 days in office) New York

What You'll Do

Prospect & Generate New Opportunities

  • Conduct high-volume outbound prospecting into RIAs across the U.S.
  • Cold call, email, and leverage LinkedIn and other prospecting tools to initiate new relationships.
  • Research target firms and identify financial advisors, CIOs, investment teams, portfolio managers, and other key decision-makers.
  • Secure qualified introductory meetings and new opportunities for the RIA Business Development team.
  • Consistently build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective RIA relationships.
  • Execute persistent, thoughtful follow-up to move prospects from initial outreach into active conversations.
  • Maintain accurate prospecting activity, contacts, opportunities, and next steps within Salesforce.
  • Identify creative ways to penetrate firms and reach decision-makers beyond traditional outbound outreach.

Support RIA Business Development

  • Partner closely with the Head of RIA Business Development to prioritize target firms and execute the broader RIA growth strategy.
  • Prepare prospect research, account intelligence, meeting materials, and follow-up.
  • Support opportunities as they progress from initial introduction through due diligence and approval.
  • Coordinate with National Accounts, Compliance, Legal, Operations, Marketing, and Sales to help move opportunities forward.
  • Track outstanding requirements, follow-ups, and next steps to maintain momentum throughout the sales process.
  • Develop an understanding of each firm's investment process, alternative investment requirements, and decision-making structure.

Build Relationships & Market Knowledge

  • Develop relationships with advisors and key stakeholders throughout the RIA ecosystem.
  • Build a strong understanding of the independent wealth management landscape and how RIAs evaluate private market investments.
  • Monitor competitor activity, market developments, and advisor demand.
  • Gather market feedback to help inform InvestX's sales approach, product positioning, and prospecting strategy.
  • Represent InvestX at select industry events, conferences, and advisor meetings.

What We're Looking For

  • 3–5+ years of sales, business development, wholesaling, lead generation, or distribution experience within wealth management, asset management, financial services, or alternative investments.
  • Demonstrated success with outbound prospecting, cold calling, and generating qualified sales opportunities.
  • Comfortable spending a significant portion of the day actively prospecting and speaking with new contacts.
  • A true hunter who enjoys building relationships from scratch rather than solely managing an existing book of business.
  • Persistent and resilient—you understand that rejection and follow-up are part of successful business development.
  • Confident communicator who is comfortable engaging financial advisors and senior investment professionals.
  • Resourceful and curious, with the ability to research firms, uncover opportunities, and find the right path into an account.
  • Competitive and motivated by measurable goals and results.
  • Highly organized with strong CRM and pipeline management discipline.
  • Self-directed and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Collaborative and excited to learn from and support senior sales leadership while building toward greater account ownership.

Nice to Have

  • Existing relationships within the RIA or broader independent wealth management ecosystem.
  • Experience with private equity, private credit, venture capital, hedge funds, or other alternative investment products.
  • Experience within an asset manager, alternative investment manager, wealth management firm, or financial technology platform.
  • Familiarity with RIA due diligence and investment approval processes.
  • Experience using Salesforce and sales prospecting platforms.
  • FINRA Series 7 and 63 or willingness to obtain relevant licensing.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role starts with your ability to consistently create new conversations and qualified RIA opportunities.

You will be measured on:

  • Outbound prospecting activity and consistency.
  • New RIA contacts and firms engaged.
  • Qualified meetings generated.
  • Growth of the RIA sales pipeline.
  • Conversion of outreach into active opportunities.
  • Progression of qualified firms into due diligence and approval.
  • Strong CRM discipline and follow-through.
  • Contribution to new RIA relationships and ultimately asset growth.

Salary & Benefits

  • 2026 base salary range is $130,000 - $160,000 USD plus incentive plan and equity
  • Actual salaries may vary based on factors, such as skill, experience, location, and qualifications for the role.   
  • Comprehensive Health & Benefit plan.

If this opportunity sounds like it is a good match with your skills, background, and career direction, please apply through our Careers Page ()

with your cover letter and resume. 

InvestX welcomes applications from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples, Indigenous peoples, visible minorities, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin. About Bluefin Payment Systems LLC

At Bluefin, we thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment where innovation and leadership are at the forefront of everything we do. Join us in revolutionizing data security within the integrated payments industry, as we protect over 35,000 companies across 59 countries with our cutting-edge encryption and tokenization technologies. Embrace the challenge of working in a vibrant atmosphere that values agility and leadership, and be part of our mission to create secure, frictionless experiences for businesses and their customers. If you’re ready to drive change and make a difference, we invite you to embark on this exciting journey with us!

About the role

The Inside Sales Representative I is a highly energetic individual who is responsible for driving revenue growth through Bluefin’s referral partner channel. The ideal candidate will perform outbound and in-bound sales and be able to close deals over the phone using exceptional communications, product knowledge, and client service skills. This role serves as a trusted advisor to merchants. This individual will independently manage merchant opportunities from initial referral through onboarding and activation, making informed decisions regarding pricing, coordinating with internal departments, and ensuring merchants receive exceptional service throughout the customer lifecycle. This is a remote position reporting to the SVP, US Sales.

What you'll do

The essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Drive achievement of Bluefin revenue, margin, and growth objectives by proactively managing inbound referral opportunities and conducting outbound sales calls to prospective merchants.
  • Own the full sales cycle for referred merchant opportunities, from initial contact and discovery through pricing, proposal, closing, onboarding, activations, and early lifecycle support.
  • Consult with merchant to understand their business needs payment acceptance environment, current challenges, and growth objectives, then position appropriate Bluefin products and services to support those needs.
  • Effectively communicate Bluefin’s value proposition, including intangible program benefits, service quality, security advantages, payment solutions, and partner-channel benefits, through phone and virtual sales conversations.
  • Independently evaluate merchant processing opportunities and recommend appropriate pricing while balancing profitability, competitive market conditions, risk considerations, and long-term relationship value.
  • Make informed decisions throughout the sales, underwriting, onboarding, and activation process to support timely merchant implementations a successful account conversion.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for referred merchants during the sales and onboarding journey, ensuring consistent communications, clear expectations, and positive client experience.
  • Partner closely with Underwriting, Risk, Activations, Relationship Management, and other internal teams to coordinate merchant approvals, documentation, pricing reviews, escalations, and activations.
  • Contribute toward minimizing client attrition through leveraging the relationship, excellent problem solving and resolution, and providing overall exceptional information and service.
  • Accurately manage leads, opportunities, activities, merchant data, and client communications within Bluefin’s CRM and internal systems with a high degree of urgency, accuracy, and completeness.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, the individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions:

  • Knowledge and understanding of payment processing products and services, knowledge of Mastercard/Visa Association rules and regulations, technical skills, contract language, credit policies, product conversions (highly desirable)
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, selling, objection and negotiation skills within inbound and outbound sales environment (desire to win!)
  • Exceptional detail-oriented, problem-solving, and analytical skills
  • Ability to manage effectively leads through a CRM system.
  • Ability to work independently for extended periods of time while achieving sales results with a high degree of self-motivation.
  • Strong team player with a positive, “can-do” attitude to achieve sales results.
  • Strong organizational skills, computer (data fields entry), and planning skills
  • Ability to adapt to a fast paced and evolving environment.

Job Description:

The AI Enablement Sr. Manager will accelerate responsible, measurable AI adoption across Marketing, Sales, and Client Experience. This role will combine hands-on AI expertise with program leadership to help teams move from ad hoc experimentation to a governed, scalable AI-enabled operating model.

The AI Enablement Sr. Manager will also lead the departmental AI Center of Excellence, develop custom GPTs and AI agents, manage training and champions programs, support responsible AI practices, measure adoption and impact, and partner with IT, Innovation, Legal, Risk, Brand, Marketing Operations, Sales Enablement, and business stakeholders to advance Baker Tilly Marketing’s AI roadmap.

Key responsibilities

1. Develop, test and maintain custom GPTs, AI agents and reusable AI-enabled workflows across Marketing, Sales and Client Experience.

  • Identify and prioritize repeatable workflows suited for AI support, including content, campaigns, sales enablement, research, reporting and work management.
  • Lead design, testing and documentation of AI solutions, including use cases, source materials, risks, limitations and human review needs.
  • Build or coordinate GPTs, agents, prompts, templates and workflow accelerators; manage optimization, usage monitoring and retirement.

2. Lead AI strategy, roadmap, governance and Center of Excellence for Marketing, Sales and Client Experience.

  • Translate AI strategy into an actionable roadmap aligned to business priorities, enterprise direction and governance standards.
  • Lead the AI Center of Excellence, including intake, prioritization, use case review, launch readiness and portfolio management.
  • Establish responsible AI standards for approved use cases, risk tiering, content quality, brand alignment, data use and escalation.

3. Design and deliver AI training, enablement and Power User/Champions programs. Develop AI literacy, responsible-use and role-based training; facilitate workshops, office hours and demos; maintain enablement resources; and support champions who model adoption and surface new opportunities.

4. Partner across functions to align AI adoption with business priorities and firm standards. Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, CX, Operations, IT, Innovation, HR/Learning, Legal, Risk, Brand, Information Security and platform owners to coordinate dependencies, support change management and resolve adoption barriers.

5. Measure and report AI adoption, usage, productivity and impact. Define KPIs, establish baselines and report progress, outcomes, risks and opportunities to department leadership.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree required
  • 8 years of experience required in marketing operations, sales enablement, CX enablement, digital transformation, AI enablement, program management, marketing technology, or related roles.
  • 2 years of experience preferred in the AI space
  • Knowledge of generative AI tools, custom GPTs, AI agents, prompt design, responsible AI and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Ability to translate AI strategy into roadmaps, governance standards, use cases, enablement and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong program, change management and organizational skills; able to manage priorities, stakeholders, timelines and adoption barriers.
  • Strong communication, facilitation and training skills; able to explain AI concepts and build user confidence.
  • Data-informed mindset; able to define KPIs, measure adoption and impact, assess risks and improve AI solutions.

Position Summary

Irth Solutions is seeking an Implementation Consultant to lead end-to-end SaaS implementations that help operators work safely and keep communities connected to critical infrastructure.

The Implementation Consultant partners closely with clients to understand their business processes, translate business needs into system requirements, and configure and implement software solutions that meet client objectives. This role is responsible for requirements gathering, configuration, training, troubleshooting, testing, documentation, and ongoing client support.

The ideal candidate is a strong individual contributor who can influence decision-makers, manage multiple priorities, communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and proactively solve complex problems. Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, organizational skills, independence, and the ability to build trusted client relationships.

Client Engagement & Requirements Gathering

  • Facilitate business requirements sessions to understand client objectives, evaluate priorities, determine feasibility, and recommend optimal solutions.

  • Identify process gaps, configuration needs, and opportunities for product enhancements.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients throughout all phases of implementation.
  • Serve as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for assigned projects.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams in Agile environments to deliver new features and enhancements.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Optimize application performance, accessibility, and user experience across devices and browsers.
  • Contribute to CI/CD processes and frontend development standards.

You Are a Good Match If You Have

  • 5+ years of experience developing frontend applications with Angular.
  • Proven experience with Angular 12+ (Angular 18+ is highly preferred).
  • Strong knowledge of TypeScript, modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and SCSS/CSS.
  • Experience building responsive and mobile-first web applications.
  • Experience consuming and integrating REST APIs.
  • Experience working with Node.js and npm for dependency management and build processes.
  • Experience with automated testing using Jest and/or Jasmine.
  • Experience with Git version control systems.
  • Strong understanding of Clean Code principles and frontend development best practices.
  • Basic knowledge of web performance optimization concepts, including lazy loading, code splitting, bundle optimization, caching, and Core Web Vitals.
  • Basic understanding of frontend security concepts, including XSS, CSRF, secure token handling, and authentication.
  • Experience working in Agile environments using Scrum, Kanban, or similar methodologies.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with end-to-end testing using Cypress.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
  • Experience with Docker and containerized environments.
  • Experience using code quality tools such as SonarQube.
  • Experience working with Design Systems and reusable component libraries.

Why Join intive?

We cultivate an environment where innovative ideas and excellence have room to thrive - even with a remote workforce. Our culture of learning rewards curiosity and gives our team members opportunities to learn, grow, and own the evolution of their careers.

  • Career Path Planning– You can create a career path based on your goals. We provide training, mentoring, and support to help you along the way.

  • Training & Mentorship– Learning and Development is a big part of our company culture. You will have unlimited access to Udemy, internal courses and training, and a robust mentorship program.

  • Hubs– You will join the community ofintiverssharing the same professional profile. There is space for knowledge sharing with people with similar capabilities to yours and to access the latest technology trends.

  • Culture & Connection– We cultivate connections within teams, across functions, and up and down the org chart. We make sure everyone is noticed and feels connected to our mission and each other.

All intive entitiesare joint controller of your personal data. Your data will be processed for recruitment purposes only. You’ll find more information, especially about your rights connected with data processing, in our Privacy Policy, especially in “Conducting recruitment activities” part.

Position Title

Workday HCM Administrator - RecruitingDays - Full TimeBroadmoor Campus, Remote

Position Summary / Career Interest:

The Analyst, HR Technology is responsible for the design, implementation and administration of HR Technology, primarily Workday, to support the strategic objectives of the health system. Partner closely with HR Centers of Excellence and business leaders across the organization to assist with process-related and reporting-related matters, including designing, implementing and managing reports and processes in Workday and other HR systems that support our business and Human Resource needs.

Responsibilities and Essential Job Functions

  • Develop, schedule and execute reports in Workday and other HR systems. Provide data analysis and recommendations as part of monthly and ad-hoc reports.

  • Create custom/ad-hoc reports in Workday and other HR Systems as needed to meet business needs and objectives, often combining data from multiple sources to achieve desired results.

  • Provide technical support and serve as a subject matter expert, providing training to educate system end-users on how to navigate and use the system. Help clients resolve reporting issues requiring in-depth expertise in the Workday solution and in other HR systems.

  • Research, troubleshoot and resolve production issues by leveraging best practices and developing long-standing solutions. Focus on identifying trends, determining root cause of problems, predicting future implications and determining solutions to drive effective business decisions.

  • Complete new configurations to tenant set-up. Maintain and develop Workday integrations.

  • Perform batch uploads and extractions of data employing transformations and calculated fields.

  • Manage Workday major release impact on configurations and integrations identifying risks and opportunities for enhancements.

  • Assist in the troubleshooting of mass data loads in Workday (EIBs).

  • Conduct regular audits to ensure data integrity.

  • Proactively identify and assist in prioritizing opportunities to streamline business and/or system processes.

  • Must be able to perform the professional, clinical and or technical competencies of the assigned unit or department.

  • These statements are intended to describe the essential functions of the job and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities. Skills and duties may vary dependent upon your department or unit. Other duties may be assigned as required.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelors Degree in Human Resources, Business, Information Systems, Computer Science or related field from an accredited college or university. Equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of education.

  • 3 or more years of experience supporting HRIS in several of the following modules: HCM, Payroll, Benefits, Recruiting, Talent/Performance Management.

  • 2 or more years of report writing experience with enterprise reporting tools for ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or PeopleSoft reporting tools, SQL).

  • Experience with configuring benefits, payroll, compensation, time off, reporting and security.

  • Experience partnering with stakeholders to understand business requirements, program needs, and demonstrated ability to translate those into realistic and innovative technology and process solutions.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Prior Workday experience.

Required Language Skills

  • Fluent English - Read, write and speak English.

Knowledge Requirements

  • Excellent written, oral and interpersonal communications skills.

  • Knowledge of building reports for HRMS and experience with development and delivery of HR metrics/dashboards.

  • Solid knowledge of HR systems, structure, functions and processes.

  • High proficiency in all Microsoft products with proven ability to learn technology quickly through instruction and self-training.

Full time

raw.excerpt: Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.
raw.description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate 3 business segments:

  1. Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations
  2. Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service
  3. FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

﻿

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 15,000 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 500 staff with an intact startup mindset.

﻿

We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia.

﻿

Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia-Pacific.

Requirements

We are looking for a detail-oriented Client Onboarding Executive to champion speed, accuracy, and compliance in the first critical stage of our clients' journey.

Based in the Philippines, you will work independently in a remote environment, driven by a passion for understanding business owners. You are proactive and committed to delivering world-class service to our clients. In this role, you will expand your technical expertise while collaborating with diverse businesses across multiple industries.

Mission

The Client Onboarding Executive ensures a smooth and fast onboarding experience for every new Sleek client. By understanding Singapore’s regulatory requirements and using AI-driven workflows, you will maintain high data accuracy and compliance. Your goal is to quickly turn new sign-ups into fully live entities with speed, precision, and a great client experience.

Outcomes

Client Journey & Service Delivery

  • End-to-End Onboarding: Own the client onboarding journey, ensuring a tailored and delightful experience that secures long-term retention.
  • Accuracy & Quality: Maintain 100% accuracy in client billings, statutory filings, and adherence to Sleek’s Terms & Conditions.
  • The "Three-Day" Vision: Execute workflows with speed and precision, relentlessly pursuing the goal of less than three business days of "Sleek Time" for client processing. Proactively inform clients in case of roadblocks or any further information needed.
  • Focus on Tangible KPIs: Maintain high CSAT and aim for lowest time to onboard.

Operational Excellence & Compliance

  • Regulatory Mastery: Apply expertise in ACRA regulations, the Companies Act 1967, and AML/CFT policies to ensure every client is onboarded with absolute compliance.
  • Workflow Efficiency: Organise daily tasks effectively to ensure all deliverables align with scope and tight timelines while maintaining strict client confidentiality. Follow SOP and onboarding processes
  • AI-Augmented Execution: Utilise Sleek’s automation and AI tools to streamline manual tasks, transitioning toward a 100% efficient, system-driven workflow.

Collaboration & Growth

  • Continuous Evolution: Participate in a "continuous improvement" loop by providing feedback to management to help refine and simplify processes every month.
  • Stakeholder Support: Collaborate with the Head of Client Onboarding and Team Leader to implement the Sleek Strategic Roadmap and scalable workflows.
  • Problem Solving: Act as a primary point of contact for client queries, resolving requests with precision and escalating complex matters when necessary.
  • Collaboration: Collaborate with Compliance, Corporate Secretary, and Sales to deliver the best experience to the client.

To do this, you will have:

  • Education: Recognised degree or diploma in Business Administration or equivalent.
  • Experience: Ideally experience in client-facing roles, handling sensitive information and complex client matters.
  • Technical Skills: Hands-on experience with Google Workspace, Microsoft applications, and various productivity software.
  • Compliance Knowledge: A good understanding of Singapore regulatory compliance (ACRA, AML/CFT) is highly preferred.
  • Mindset: Self-motivated, proactive, and highly organised with a "detail-oriented" approach.
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, technology-driven, and VUCA environment.
  • Communication: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to effectively support entrepreneurs.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility: There is so much we don’t know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you’re more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

Data driven: We are a data rich business with ~15,000 small customers. Each decision we make can impact many more people than we realise - so it’s critical that we use sound data to support our strategies and review the success of our initiatives.

Can have tough conversations in a positive way: It’s not a matter of if, but when difficult interpersonal situations arise. Disagreement, conflict and disappointment are a given in a fast moving business where people care about their work. People that proactively have tough conversations with kindness build empathy, trust and great working relationships.

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the below interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

Whether the interviews are held over video call or in person will depend on your location and the role.

One-Way Video Interview/ TA Screen

The first step in our process is either a One-Way Video Interview or a meeting with our Talent Acquisition team.Both formats are designed to explore your professional background and align on your expectations for the role.

Technical Round

A ~60 minute chat with the Hiring Manager. They’ll discuss your last 1-2 roles to understand your experience in more detail.

Soft Skills Assessment

A ~45 minute chat with a leadership team, where they will dive into some of your recent work situations to understand how you think and work.

Offer + reference interviews

We’ll make a non-binding offer verbally or over email, followed by a couple of short phone or video calls with references that you provide to us.

+++++

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.

This may include using external vendors to verify the below:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at sleek.com.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: You’ll be able to work from home 5 days per week. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we’ve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we’ve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

raw.description:
Who We Are:

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

Power Digital Marketing is looking for a Programmatic Media Manager who will be responsible for driving performance, strategy, and account growth for major multi-channel paid media clients. The Programmatic Media Manager will report directly to the Programmatic Supervisor, who will help guide strategy, vendor, and client relationships that will guide the media execution for this role. The Programmatic Media Manager will support media strategy and planning and be responsible for execution, analysis, reporting, and communicating updates with the team.

The Programmatic Media Manager should have strong media management skills and be able to lead as the subject matter expert in internal meetings and with ad platform partners, while contributing in client meetings. You will have experience deploying paid media strategies across multiple channels, guiding an internal team towards successfully driving business growth for clients, and confidently defending critical elements of the work.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Successful management of designated paid media accounts
  • Meet pacing and KPI requirements for held accounts based on set goals and improved performance expectations.
  • Work with Account Managers and the Media Supervisor to identify client goals, priorities and efficiency requirements.
  • Work with Account Managers & the Media Supervisor to identify client goals, priorities & efficiency requirements, ultimately improving Paid Media’s contribution to business success.
  • Actively works to increase billing & channel support for existing media accounts & propose opportunities to expand media coverage for new accounts.
  • Continually work to learn new strategies, test new platforms & expand Cardinal’s paid media offerings.
  • Function as the primary point of contact both internally & externally for all ‘owned’ accounts, responsible for pacing & performance of accounts.
  • Responsible for generating reports, writing insights & communicating with the client for designated accounts.
  • Responsible for the ongoing maintenance of held accounts, including but not limited to optimizations, structural updates, bidding methodologies, conversion types, and copy revisions.
  • Contribution to Paid Media strategy for assigned accounts, working with the Media Supervisor as needed.
  • Responsible for strategic ideation on all accounts, designing & adjusting campaign strategies to meet each client’s business goals (and internal objectives).
  • Responsible for designing & deploying tests in accounts on a monthly & quarterly cadence (structural, targeting, creative & messaging, conversion, etc).
  • Responsible for continual testing, verification & improvement of full-funnel structures.

Role Requirements:

  • 2-5+ years of Paid Media experience
  • Experience managing multiple paid media accounts with budgets ranging between $200K-$1MM.per month.
  • Extensive experience in campaign management & strategy across programmatic ad platforms, including DSPs ( Viant, StackAdapt, Cadent, Illumin, The Trade Desk, DV360, etc.), DMPs, and other data and ad tech partners.
  • Experience directly managing campaigns, as well as working with partners via managed service.
  • Experience in campaign management & strategy across additional platforms is a plus, but not required (Google Ads, Bing Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, etc.)
  • Experience with full funnel strategy, lead generation, and measuring incremental lift.
  • Experience with Google Analytics, GTM, conversion and optimization strategy (GA4 knowledge a plus).
  • Ability to write ad copy, guide creative strategy, identify asset requirements and establish a creative testing cadence.
  • Client relationship management experience. Reporting insights, identifying & optimizing towards client business goals.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Managing a full workload indicated by $30K revenue/employee
  • 90% Client Retention, evaluated biannually
  • Pace within 98% of budget goal
  • Reaching conversion goals within 95% of target
  • 100% of deliverables / tasks completed on time (by specified due date) or proactively communicate if delayed

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Strategically Manage and Communicate Performance Insights
  • Excellence in channel production and account performance
  • Strong client and team communication

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

raw.excerpt: The Life and Critical Illness Underwriting Co-Signer is a critical role within Manulife’s underwriting organization, responsible for delivering high-quality, competitive underwriting decisions while actively developing the next generation of underwriting talent.
raw.description:
The Life and Critical Illness Underwriting Co-Signer is a critical role within Manulife’s underwriting organization, responsible for delivering high-quality, competitive underwriting decisions while actively developing the next generation of underwriting talent. This role supports Manulife’s underwriting philosophy by partnering with underwriters on complex and high-value files, strengthening decision quality, and ensuring sound risk management practices are consistently applied.

In addition to co-signing decisions, the Underwriting Co-Signer plays an important role in training, coaching, and shaping future-ready underwriting capabilities. The individual will help underwriters build confidence, critical thinking, judgment, and business awareness in an environment where digital tools, AI-enabled insights, and evolving customer expectations are changing how underwriting work is performed. Through active mentorship, file review, feedback, and collaboration, this role helps create a stronger underwriting pipeline and supports the future of underwriting at Manulife.

Key Responsibilities

  • Underwriting Decisions: Evaluate and make underwriting decisions on life and critical illness insurance applications with approval limits up to $10 million, ensuring decisions align with Manulife’s underwriting philosophy, risk appetite, and regulatory expectations.

  • Co-Signing and File Review: Partner with assigned underwriters to review complex, high-value, or development-focused files, assessing the underwriting approach, evidence ordered, documentation, decision rationale, and customer/advisor impact.

  • Training and Development: Actively train, coach, and mentor underwriters to build technical expertise, critical thinking, decision confidence, and readiness for increased approval limits and broader underwriting responsibilities.

  • Future of Underwriting Capability Building: Support the development of future-ready underwriting skills, including effective use of digital tools, AI-enabled decision support, data-driven insights, and continuous improvement practices.

  • Decision Quality and Consistency: Promote consistent application of underwriting guidelines, Manulife’s philosophy, financial and medical underwriting principles, and appropriate risk management practices.

  • Business and Customer Impact: Help underwriters understand the broader business impact of their decisions, including requirement ordering, amendments, advisor communication, cycle time, customer experience, persistency, and competitive positioning.

  • Volume and Service Expectations: Manage co-signing and underwriting work efficiently, supporting service standards and timely decision-making while balancing quality, development, and business priorities.

  • Coaching Conversations and Feedback: Provide timely, constructive feedback through case discussions, coaching sessions, office hours, and file reviews to accelerate underwriter development and reinforce learning.

  • Collaboration: Work collaboratively with underwriting leaders, Risk Management, Research, medical directors, and new business to support consistent decisions and a seamless customer and advisor experience.

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve underwriting processes, documentation, training approaches, requirement ordering, and use of tools to strengthen underwriting outcomes and future capabilities.

Qualifications

  • Experience: A minimum of 5 years of experience in life and critical illness underwriting, with a proven track record of handling complex and high-value cases.

  • Technical Expertise: Strong knowledge of life and critical illness underwriting, including medical, financial, non-medical, product, and persistency considerations.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in finance, business, health sciences, or a related field is preferred. Professional underwriting designations or progress toward designations such as FALU, FLMI, ACS, or equivalent are highly desirable.

  • Coaching and Development: Demonstrated ability to mentor, coach, and develop underwriters through practical case review, feedback, structured learning, and knowledge sharing.

  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical, judgment, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess risk, challenge assumptions, and apply guidelines with sound business context.

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex decisions clearly and constructively to underwriters, leaders, advisors, and internal partners.

  • Digital Mindset: Comfort with underwriting technology, digital tools, data insights, and AI-enabled decision support, with a willingness to help others adopt new ways of working.

  • Leadership Behaviours: Ability to model collaboration, curiosity, accountability, adaptability, and a continuous improvement mindset in a fast-paced underwriting environment.

Performance Metrics

  • Decision Accuracy and Risk Management: Maintain strong underwriting decision quality, with decisions aligned to Manulife’s philosophy, guidelines, audit expectations, and risk management standards.

  • Co-Signing Quality and Consistency: Demonstrate consistent, timely, and development-focused co-signing that improves file quality, decision rationale, documentation, and underwriter independence.

  • Underwriter Development Impact: Support measurable improvement in underwriter confidence, technical capability, approval-limit readiness, decision consistency, and ability to work more independently.

  • Service and Cycle Time: Contribute to timely file review and decision-making, supporting service standards while maintaining quality and development expectations.

  • Training and Knowledge Sharing: Actively participate in case clinics, coaching sessions, office hours, and training activities that strengthen team capability and support the future of underwriting.

  • Future-Ready Capability Adoption: Encourage effective use of digital tools, AI-enabled insights, data, and process improvements to help underwriters build the skills required for a changing underwriting environment.

  • Business Impact: Support improved customer and advisor experience through better requirement ordering, clearer communication, consistent decisions, and stronger alignment between risk management and business outcomes.

When you join our team:

  • We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.

  • We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are

  • more than just words.

  • As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see

Reports to: Manager, Service Provider Sales
